raw.description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Mule ESB Developer
L

ocation: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $130,000–$180,000 Annually (based on experience)
Experience Required:10+ Years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a highly experienced Mule ESB Developer with 10+ years of enterprise integration experience, including extensive expertise with the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform. The ideal candidate will design, develop, and operate enterprise-scale integration solutions using API-led connectivity principles while driving architecture, governance, security, and performance optimization across complex integration landscapes. This role requires a hands-on technical leader capable of delivering highly scalable, secure, and reusable integration solutions while mentoring engineering teams and collaborating with enterprise architects, application owners, and business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise integration solutions using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, Anypoint Studio, and Mule Runtime.
  • Architect API-led connectivity solutions, defining reusable System APIs, Process APIs, and Experience APIs aligned with enterprise integration standards.
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs, SOAP services, GraphQL APIs, and asynchronous integration patterns using DataWeave, RAML, and OpenAPI specifications.
  • Develop reusable integration components, connectors, policies, templates, and shared services to accelerate enterprise integration initiatives.
  • Deploy and manage Mule applications on CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, Hybrid, or on-premises environments while ensuring scalability and high availability.
  • Implement enterprise API security using OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT, mTLS, API gateways, and Anypoint API Manager.
  • Design event-driven integration solutions using Anypoint MQ, Apache Kafka, JMS, or enterprise messaging platforms.
  • Integrate enterprise systems including Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics, and cloud-based SaaS applications.
  • Optimize integration performance, troubleshoot production issues, conduct root cause analysis, and implement long-term reliability improvements.
  • Establish CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, API governance, monitoring, logging, and observability using enterprise DevOps best practices.
  • Collaborate with enterprise architects, product owners, developers, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable integration solutions.
  • Lead architecture reviews, perform code reviews, mentor integration engineers, and establish enterprise integration development standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 10+ years of professional experience in enterprise application integration, including 5+ years of hands-on MuleSoft Anypoint Platform experience.
  • Expert-level proficiency with Anypoint Studio, DataWeave 2.x, Mule Runtime, and API development.
  • Extensive experience implementing API-led connectivity, REST APIs, SOAP services, RAML, OpenAPI, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Strong hands-on experience deploying Mule applications on CloudHub, Runtime Fabric, Hybrid, or on-premises environments.
  • Deep understanding of API security, authentication, authorization, encryption, and API governance using OAuth 2.0, JWT, mTLS, and Anypoint API Manager.
  • Experience implementing event-driven architectures using Anypoint MQ, Kafka, JMS, or similar messaging technologies.
  • Extensive experience integrating enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Oracle ERP, and cloud-based applications.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools, Git, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and technical leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • MuleSoft Certified Developer, MuleSoft Certified Integration Architect, or MuleSoft Platform Architect certification.
  • Experience deploying MuleSoft solutions across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or hybrid cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with FinOps, cloud cost optimization, and enterprise integration governance.
  • Experience implementing Zero Trust API security, API lifecycle management, and enterprise security frameworks.
  • Working knowledge of GraphQL, AsyncAPI, event streaming architectures, and modern integration technologies.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.
Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Bright Vision Technologies (BV Teck) is committed to equal employment opportunity (EEO) for all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status as defined by applicable federal, state, or local laws. This commitment extends to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, training, compensation, promotion, transfer, leaves of absence, termination, layoffs, and recall.

BV Teck expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment or discrimination. Any improper interference with employees' ability to perform their job duties may result in disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment.

Group Finance Director – Insurance & Investments

About the Role

The Group Finance Director is a senior leadership position responsible for overseeing the Group's financial management, planning, reporting, controls, treasury, and performance across its insurance, investment, asset management, and other financial services businesses.

The role provides strategic financial leadership across subsidiaries and business units, ensuring strong financial performance, regulatory compliance, capital discipline, effective risk management, and high-quality decision support for the Group CFO, CEO, Board, and shareholders.

Key Responsibilities

Lead Group-wide financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance management.

Oversee consolidated financial reporting, management accounts, statutory accounts, and financial analysis across subsidiaries.

Drive FP&A, profitability analysis, cost optimization, and financial performance improvement.

Monitor financial performance across insurance, investments, asset management, and other Group businesses.

Oversee insurance finance, including premium revenue, claims, reserves, reinsurance, underwriting performance, and profitability analysis.

Lead financial reporting and accounting oversight for investment and asset management portfolios, including valuation, income, performance, and reporting.

Support Group-level capital planning, solvency, liquidity, and balance-sheet management.

Oversee treasury, cash management, funding requirements, and working-capital optimization.

Strengthen Group-wide financial controls, governance, policies, and risk management frameworks.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, insurance regulations, investment regulations, and statutory reporting obligations.

Provide financial analysis for M&A, joint ventures, strategic investments, restructuring, and capital allocation decisions.

Partner with senior executives to improve business-unit profitability, operating efficiency, and return on capital.

Lead finance transformation, including ERP, automation, management reporting, analytics, and digital finance initiatives.

Develop and mentor Finance Directors, Controllers, Heads of Finance, and senior finance teams across the Group.

Act as a key financial advisor to the Group CFO, CEO, Executive Committee, Board, auditors, regulators, investors, and other stakeholders.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Group revenue, EBITDA/profitability, and earnings growth

ROE / ROIC and return on capital

Budget and forecast accuracy

Cost-to-income and expense efficiency

Insurance underwriting and investment profitability

Capital adequacy and solvency position

Liquidity and treasury efficiency

Investment portfolio financial performance

Quality and timeliness of Group reporting

Regulatory and statutory compliance

Strength of internal controls and audit outcomes

Successful finance transformation and process automation

Value creation across subsidiaries and business units

Candidate Profile

15–20+ years of progressive finance experience, preferably within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience operating at Group / regional / multi-entity level.

Previous experience as Group Finance Director, Finance Director, Group Financial Controller, Deputy Group CFO, Financial Controller, or senior finance executive.

Strong understanding of insurance accounting, investment accounting, financial reporting, capital management, treasury, and regulatory finance.

Demonstrated experience managing complex consolidated reporting structures and multiple subsidiaries.

Strong commercial understanding of investment portfolios, financial markets, capital allocation, and business performance.

Experience supporting M&A, corporate transactions, strategic investments, or restructuring is highly desirable.

Strong leadership experience managing geographically dispersed finance teams.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's/Master's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent is strongly preferred.

Additional qualifications in insurance, investment management, or financial risk are advantageous.

Core Competencies

Strategic Finance | Group Consolidation | FP&A | Financial Reporting | Insurance Finance | Investment Finance | Capital Management | Treasury | Solvency | Financial Controls | Regulatory Reporting | M&A | Risk Management | Tax | Finance Transformation | Investor & Board Reporting

Leadership Characteristics

Strategic and commercially minded

Strong analytical and financial judgment

High integrity and governance orientation

Excellent stakeholder and Board communication

Results-driven and performance-focused

Strong people leadership and succession-planning capability

Comfortable operating in complex, regulated, multi-entity environments

Reporting Line

Reports to: Group CFO / Group CEO

Key Stakeholders: Board of Directors, Executive Committee, Group CFO, CEOs/MDs of subsidiaries, Investment & Risk teams, Regulators, Auditors, Investors, and Shareholders.

Target Sourcing Titles

Group Finance Director | Group Financial Director | Group CFO | Deputy Group CFO | Finance Director | Group Financial Controller | Financial Controller | Regional Finance Director | Director of Finance | Head of Group Finance | Head of Finance | VP Finance | Deputy CFO | Finance Executive Director | Group Finance Controller

raw.description:
POSITION SUMMARY:

Oversees a team of analysts responsible for the coordination, training and implementation of Epic Willow Ambulatory. The primary responsibility is to ensure that applications are well supported and that implementations are properly executed to meet organizational standards. The Applications Analyst IV must possess a thorough understanding of medical terminology, technology and clinical workflows. As an assigned application and department liaison, this position will be responsible for coordinating training, troubleshooting, configuration and error resolution for new and existing applications.

This position involves working closely with end-users and ITS management staff to manage the development and implementation of new features and functions. The Applications Analyst IV partners with their assigned departments and helps to identify user requirements, utilize available technologies, develop detailed interface and conversion specifications and recommend software solution options.

For large scale projects, this role will take the lead in the development and implementation of new features or enhancements. Projects are likely to include; identifying user requirements, developing detailed interfaces, planning for system conversions and recommending software solution options. For other projects, this role will provide oversight and project management to a team of analysts.

Position: Team Lead - Epic Willow Ambulatory

Department: EHR

Schedule: 40 hours

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, guide and motivate direct reports through demonstration of best practices.

  • Capable of supervising all aspects of day-to-day operations and support. Demonstrated analytical, problem-solving and conceptual skills.

  • Strong software and application knowledge required, with base knowledge of relevant technologies preferred.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Solid understanding of business environment and operations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

  • Associate's degree in Computer Science, Information Management or related field (or equivalent combination of formal education and experience).

  • Bachelor's degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • At least five years of information systems experience as a senior clinical/business analyst or project manager required.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Close attention to detail, ability to carefully monitor processes and organize and maintain a system of records.

  • Able to clearly present information through the spoken or written word; read and interpret complex information; talk with customers or clients; listen well.

  • Provide quality customer service and serve as an exemplary representative of Information Systems. On-going communication, feedback and follow-through with customers/peers are essential Negotiate and acquire resources as necessary to appropriately implement projects.

  • Assure work assignments for team are completed in accordance with an established project timeline.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Solid understanding of business environment and operations.

  • Able to identify complex problems, their probable causes, their impact on operations, report them to the appropriate parties, offer possible solutions, and decide on the optimal course of action while exhibiting judgment and realistic understanding of issues; able to independently and/or collaboratively bring problems to complete resolution.

Compensation Range:

$89,500.00- $130,000.00

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensures as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), discretionary annual bonuses and merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family well-being.

NOTE: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disabled/Veterans

raw.description:
About FitOn

FitOn is a market leader in virtual healthcare, connecting 20+ million consumers, 19,000+ employers, and innovative health plans with personalized care and health and wellness experiences. As part of our team, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, contribute your ideas to life-changing products and services, and have fun doing it.

Position Summary

We are seeking a compassionate, Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to join our virtual care team on a fully remote, PRN (as needed basis). In this role, you will provide high quality, culturally competent nutrition counseling to patients across the Northeast. The ideal candidate is patient-centered, detail oriented, and experienced in providing virtual care through secure telehealth platforms. This position offers flexibility, a low-time commitment (ideal candidate will have availability during evenings and weekends), and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of patients. The ideal candidate has certifications in multiple (2+) states across the United States. Preferred licenses in the following states: North Carolina, South Carolina, Illinois, and Texas.

Compensation

  • This position is a 1099 contractor position, and will be paid on a per-visit/per-hour basis.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct comprehensive nutritional assessments and develop individualized care plans based on evidence based guidelines.
  • Provide medical nutrition therapy for a range of chronic and acute conditions, via one-on-one sessions.
  • Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation using the designated electronic health record (EHR) system.
  • Coordinate care and communicate effectively with referring physicians, care coordinators, and other interdisciplinary team members.
  • Educate patients on healthy eating habits, lifestyle changes, and nutrition-related disease management in a virtual setting.
  • Create and implement targeted nutrition programs for various populations, including those managing diabetes, heart disease, or pursuing athletic performance goals.
  • Ensure compliance with both state and federal regulations, including proper coding and documentation
  • Support ongoing quality improvement initiatives and participate in team training or case reviews as needed.
  • Uphold professional, confidentiality, and HIPAA compliance at all times.

Qualifications:

  • Flexible availability, including days, evenings/nights, and weekends
  • Active certification by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).
  • MUST maintain active state licensure and current CDR credential necessary to practice as a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) in all assigned states. Active multi-state licensure required.
  • Preference for licensure in NC, SC, IL, and TX (Open to other states)
  • Proof of active professional liability insurance coverage.
  • Bilingual, particularly Spanish-speaking, is a plus but not required
  • Experience with weight management and cardiometabolic conditions
  • Experience with weight management and cardiometabolic conditions
  • Proficiency with electronic health record (EHR) systems.
  • Prior experience in virtual health or telehealth nutrition counseling is preferred but not required.
  • Candidates must successfully pass a background check and maintain good standing with the applicable state(s) board.

Location

  • Remote, must be located in the United States.

raw.description:
Position Title:

This position is a subject matter expert in global medical device and quality system regulations and is responsible for regulatory strategy and planning, authoring and submitting regulatory applications, assessing product design, manufacturing, labeling and quality system changes, authoring change impact assessments, and ensuring product labeling documentation, labels, promotional material, and product claims are accurate and compliant with global regulations. The Specialist will ensure adherence to company policy and procedures and will assist in maintaining quality control processes. This position will help the organization maximize the number of patients served while maintaining a high level of quality and safety through the support of the business functions.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provides regulatory support to product development and business teams including preparation of regulatory opinion documents, coordination of labeling activities, and review/approval of design control documentation, risk management reports, technical protocols/reports, clinical documentation and other outputs of product development.
  • Prepares/writes, submits, and manages global regulatory applications (including MDSAP markets, EU, and UK) as well as internal regulatory file documentation. Supports distributors and business partners in securing and maintaining regulatory clearances.
  • Maintains systems for tracking current projects and for projection of future activity loads.
  • Acts as company representative, developing and maintaining positive relationships with global regulatory agencies and business partners through oral and written communications.
  • Works professionally and cooperatively with cross-functional teams such as research and development, operations, quality, microbiology, packaging, medical affairs, and clinical affairs to ensure project success.
  • Assesses product design, labeling, quality system, manufacturing, and material changes for regulatory impact. Communicates changes effectively throughout the organization. Authors key portions of company responses to proposed standards, directives, policies and legislation regarding company products and systems.
  • Develops, processes, and maintains assigned departmental procedures, work instructions, and forms, and facilities training. Reviews and supports creation/updates of labeling procedures.
  • Supports the design, development, review, and approval of product labels, label items, advertising/promotional materials and product claims to assure accuracy, consistency and compliance to global regulatory requirements, as well as company and customer requirements. This includes verification of labels and advertising/promotional materials, and creation, verification, review, and processing of instructions for use.
  • Monitors and assesses changes to global regulatory regulations, directives, standards and guidance requirements (regulatory intelligence assessment). Manage project teams for completion of required activities to ensure compliance.
  • Supports regulatory aspects of the quality system and product non-conformities and leads assigned corrective and preventive action activities.
  • Front-room participation in internal audits. Back-room participation in external audits.

This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all essential functions.

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE REQUIRED AND/OR PREFERRED:

  • A minimum of a bachelor’s degree in a scientific or technical discipline, preferably in regulatory, engineering, or biological science plus 3 or more years of relevant experience; in lieu of degree, 5 or more years of relevant experience may suffice.
  • RAC certification(s) a plus

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

Technical Competencies

  • Computer Skills - Skilled with computers, takes advantage of new technology, learns new tools quickly, uses technology to enhance job performance
  • Budget - Uses resources efficiently, strives to reduce cost
  • Innovation - Creative, offers new ideas, amenable to change, risk taker
  • Job Knowledge - Understands facets of job, aware of duties and responsibilities, keeps job knowledge current. Strong understanding of other functional items including product development, design controls and risk management. Strong understanding of medical terminology, regulations, and guidelines related to medical devices and quality systems including FDA’s Quality Management System Regulation (QMSR), MDD 93/42/EEC, MDR 2017/745, and ISO 13485.
  • Organization Skills - Information organized and accessible, maintains efficient workspace, manages time well
  • Product Expertise - Knows product features, understands marketplace, shares expertise with others
  • Professional Development - Seeks to identify one’s self-improvement opportunities at work and takes appropriate action to address
  • Project Management - Monitors status of projects, thoroughly deals with project details, holds project owners accountable, delivers clear, accurate depiction of status
  • Quality - Strives to eliminate errors, accurate work is a priority, seeks opportunities to improve product/services
  • Technical Skills - Maintains understanding of technical processes/equipment, uses technology to increase performance/productivity

Behavioral & Basic Skill Competencies

  • Adaptability - Adapts to change, open to new ideas and responsibilities
  • Communication – Communicates proficiently (written and verbal), delivers presentations, has good listening skills
  • Conflict Management - Good listener, committed to finding solution to problems, works well with difficult people
  • Customer Focus - Working cooperatively with internal and external customers in a manner that demonstrates a clear commitment to their needs and success
  • Decision Making - Able to reach decisions, takes thoughtful approach when considering options, seeks input from others, makes difficult decisions
  • Dependability - Meets deadlines, works independently, accountable, maintains focus, punctual, good attendance record
  • Details – High attention to detail
  • Ethics - Honest, accountable, maintains confidentiality
  • Initiative - Takes action, seeks new opportunities, strives to see projects to completion
  • Interpersonal Skills - Builds strong relationships, is flexible/adaptable, works well with others, solicits feedback
  • Problem Solving/Critical Thinking - Strives to understands contributing factors, works to resolve complex situations
  • Productivity - Manages workload, works efficiently, meets goals and objectives
  • Results Driven - Defines appropriate goals, works toward achieving goals, articulates vision and steps for achievement.
  • Results/Productivity - Working in a productive, dependable, and efficient manner to produce high quality results in accordance with deadlines and other expectations.
  • Self-Development - Looks for opportunities to increase knowledge, works to increase responsibility, strives to achieve personal goals
  • Sense of Urgency - Meets deadlines, establishes appropriate priority, gets the job done in a timely manner, able to work under pressure
  • Strategic Thought - Works to establish and articulate visions, shows creativity when defining solutions
  • Teamwork - Demonstrating high levels of teamwork and ability to work cross-functionally

This position requires the use of personal protective equipment during various tasks/activities including but not limited to scrubs, gloves, masks, safety glasses, and safety shoes.

raw.excerpt: AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home.
raw.description:
AnewHealth is one of the nation’s leading pharmacy care management companies that specializes in caring for people with the most complex, chronic needs—wherever they call home. We enable better outcomes for patients and the healthcare organizations who support them. Established in 2023 through the combination of ExactCare and Tabula Rasa HealthCare, we provide a suite of solutions that includes comprehensive pharmacy services; full-service pharmacy benefit management; and specialized support services for Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly. With over 1,400 team members, we care for more than 100,000 people across all 50 states.

Job Details

The Quality Improvement (QI) Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting quality assurance and performance improvement initiatives within the ExactCare division. This role is responsible for managing quality-related event (QRE) reporting, monitoring compliance to quality management standards, supporting regulatory adherence, and collaborating across departments to improve service quality, patient safety, and performance outcomes. The QI Coordinator will also assist with internal and client-facing reporting, track and analyze performance data, participate in quality committee meetings, and help ensure a consistent, patient-centered approach to service delivery.

Responsibilities

Primary Functions

  • Manage Quality Reporting Process:

    • Monitor closed QREs within the ticketing system to ensure investigations are finalized and properly documented

    • Collaborate with external teams to confirm accuracy, completeness, and resolution of reported events.

    • Verify data accuracy and completeness to support tracking, trending, and reporting.

    • Close tickets in alignment with established procedures and timelines.

    • Maintain data quality and reporting readiness through continuous system monitoring.

    • Generate and distribute monthly QRE reports for stakeholders and clients.

  • Quality and Compliance Support:

    • Maintain adherence to internal quality standards and regulatory guidelines by supporting AnewHealth quality and compliance efforts.

  • Performance Improvement Collaboration:

    • Partner with service line and department leaders to identify improvement opportunities, create and support in-service training, and deliver onboarding education.

    • Assist in the development, implementation, and evaluation of internal and external performance improvement initiatives.

    • Support the collection and sharing of best practices across teams to enhance consistency and quality of service delivery

    • Contributes to action plans that address identified gaps in performance or compliance

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align quality initiatives with organizational goals and client expectations

  • Data Reporting & Analysis:

    • Generate and distribute quality and performance reports to internal stakeholders and clients.

    • Monitor referral source reports, analyze trends, and identify opportunities for improvement.

    • Follow up on internal and external communications related to quality concerns.

  • Administrative Participation:

    • Coordinate and document monthly client communication reports.

    • Participate in QI meetings and maintain meeting minutes.

    • Support the development and updates of the annual QI Plan and Program.

Secondary Functions

  • Provide operational support to other business units during periods of high volume, as needed.

The above essential functions are representative of major duties of positions in this job classification. Specific duties and responsibilities may vary based upon departmental needs. Other duties may be assigned similar to the above consistent with knowledge, skills and abilities required for the job. Not all of the duties may be assigned to a position.

Qualifications: These represent the desired qualifications of the ideal candidate. They are not meant to limit consideration for candidates who do not meet all of the standards listed. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Education

  • High school diploma or equivalent required.

  • Associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.

Experience

  • 2+ years of pharmacy experience required.

  • Experience in quality improvement or performance improvement in a healthcare setting is strongly preferred.

Certifications

  • Preferred: Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), Certified Professional Patient Safety (CPPS), Certified Professional in Healthcare Risk Management (CPHRM), or Six Sigma certification.

  • Required: Pharmacy Technician Certification

Skills & Abilities

  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).

  • Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Comfortable with data interpretation and presenting findings.

  • Demonstrates initiative, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.

  • Passionate about patient safety and quality of care.

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

  • High degree of integrity, professionalism, and reliability.

Core Competencies

  • Integrity – Maintains ethical standards and confidentiality.

  • Quality-Oriented – Focuses on delivering high-quality outcomes.

  • Innovative – Brings creative solutions to performance challenges.

  • Steadfast – Demonstrates resilience and commitment to organizational goals.

Physical/Mental Demands: This position is administrative in nature and will present physical demands requisite to a position requiring: hearing, seeing, sitting, standing, talking, and walking. The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Must be able to commute to multiple site locations within assigned territory. May be necessary to work extended hours as needed.

Schedule: This is a full-time position with an expectation to work an average of 40 hours per week and be available outside of normal business hours to meet customer expectations on an ad-hoc basis. Schedules are set to accommodate the requirements of the position and the needs of the organization and may be adjusted as needed.

Position Summary

The Program Manager – Clinical Operations is responsible for leading strategic programs and operational initiatives supporting Care Management, Utilization Management, Care Coordination, Population Health, and Value-Based Care services. This role will drive program execution, operational excellence, quality improvement, and performance outcomes across clinical operations while ensuring alignment with organizational goals and client expectations.

The Program Manager will partner closely with clinical leaders, physicians, nurses, care managers, operations teams, analytics teams, and client stakeholders to improve member outcomes, optimize healthcare utilization, and enhance operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Program Leadership & Execution

  • Lead end-to-end management of clinical operations programs, including planning, implementation, monitoring, and optimization.

  • Establish program governance, project plans, milestones, and performance metrics.
  • Ensure timely delivery of strategic initiatives while meeting quality, operational, and financial objectives.

Clinical Operations Management

  • Collaborate with clinical leadership to improve care management workflows and operational processes.
  • Drive initiatives focused on reducing avoidable admissions, readmissions, emergency department utilization, and total cost of care.
  • Support implementation and enhancement of clinical programs targeting high-risk and complex populations.
  • Ensure operational readiness for new client implementations, program expansions, and process transformations.

Population Health & Value-Based Care

  • Support value-based care initiatives through performance monitoring and outcome improvement strategies.
  • Utilize healthcare analytics to identify care gaps, risk trends, utilization patterns, and intervention opportunities.
  • Partner with quality and clinical teams to improve HEDIS, STAR, and other quality performance measures.
  • Monitor key population health metrics and recommend improvement actions.

Stakeholder & Client Management

  • Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Facilitate collaboration across clinical, operational, technology, quality, and analytics teams.
  • Present program performance, operational updates, risks, and recommendations to leadership and clients.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

  • Ensure adherence to NCQA, CMS, HIPAA, URAC, and client-specific requirements.

  • Monitor operational quality metrics and implement corrective action plans when necessary.
  • Promote a culture of continuous quality improvement.

Performance Management & Analytics

  • Develop and monitor KPIs, operational dashboards, and program scorecards.
  • Analyze trends related to productivity, utilization, quality outcomes, and member engagement.
  • Identify opportunities for operational optimization through data-driven decision-making.
  • Provide executive-level reporting and actionable insights.

Risk & Change Management

  • Identify program risks, operational challenges, and process gaps.
  • Develop mitigation strategies and manage change initiatives across teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Healthcare Administration, Nursing, Public Health, Life Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of experience in healthcare operations, care management, utilization management, population health, or clinical program management.
  • 3+ years of experience leading cross-functional programs or large-scale operational initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare payer and provider operations.
  • Experience working with clinical and operational performance metrics.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, MSN, or equivalent).
  • PMP, Lean Six Sigma, PMP, or Healthcare Quality certifications.
  • Experience with Value-Based Care, Risk Adjustment, Population Health Management, HEDIS, STAR Ratings, or Care Management programs.
  • Familiarity with EMR/EHR systems, care management platforms, and healthcare analytics tools.

  • Healthcare Analytics & Reporting
  • Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

Position Summary

Part-time Senior Technical Professional – Weather Radar

KBR is seeking a Part-Time Senior Technical Professional – Weather Radar to provide technical and operational subject matter expertise in weather radar systems, radar data quality, operational meteorology, and environmental observations. The successful candidate will support research, technical assessments, validation methodologies, and development of operational guidance related to weather radar technologies and their application across NOAA, the National Weather Service, and other federal weather and environmental programs. The role will contribute expertise in radar signal processing, radar data quality evaluation, operational forecasting applications, and the assessment of emerging observing capabilities to support scientific, operational, and mission-focused objectives

Responsibilities

  • Provide subject matter expertise in weather radar systems, radar data quality, radar data interpretation, and operational meteorology.
  • Support technical assessments and analyses related to weather radar technologies, environmental observations, and emerging observing capabilities.
  • Assess radar data quality, performance characteristics, limitations, and operational applicability of radar products and observing systems.
  • Provide operational forecasting and weather service mission perspectives to support technical evaluations and solution development.
  • Develop training concepts and materials, reports, presentations, and/or other documentation describing findings, recommendations, and best practices related to weather radar observations and applications.
  • Collaborate with scientists, engineers, meteorologists, and program staff to evaluate technical solutions and support mission-focused objectives for federal customers.
  • Provide technical recommendations regarding radar modernization, operational implementation considerations, and adoption of emerging weather observation capabilities.

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Physical Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum of 20 years of experience supporting operational meteorology, weather radar systems, operational forecasting training, or related atmospheric programs.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of weather radar principles, radar data interpretation, radar signal processing concepts, and radar data quality considerations.
  • Experience evaluating weather radar products, performance characteristics, limitations, and operational applications.
  • Experience supporting weather forecasting, warning operations, environmental monitoring, or related operational decision-support functions.
  • Experience developing and delivering technical training, instructional materials, technical reports, presentations, or other customer-facing documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to scientific, technical, and operational audiences.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams in support of federal government programs.

Areas of Desired Experience & Skills

  • Advanced degree in Meteorology, Atmospheric Science, Physical Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
  • Experience supporting operational use, evaluation, modernization, or implementation of weather radar capabilities within a government, research, or operational forecasting environment.
  • Familiarity with mission-critical weather forecasting and warning operations, including application of weather radar data to support operational decision making.
  • Experience collaborating with scientific research, engineering, and operational stakeholders to transition new capabilities into operational use.

Wir glauben an die Macht des Feedbacks.

FEEDBACKPEOPLE ist eine inhabergeführte Beratung für Management-Diagnostik und Führungskräfteentwicklung. Unser deutschlandweit verteiltes Team aus Berater:innen, Psycholog:innen und Digitalexpert:innen führt Assessment-Center, Management Audits und Development Center durch und begleitet Führungskräfte namhafter Unternehmen in Trainings und Entwicklungsprogrammen. Zu uns gehört auch GrowInTheRole, unser Kölner Start-up für KI-gestützte Gesprächssimulationen – zusammen sind wir rund 30 Kolleg:innen plus Werkstudent:innen und Praktikant:innen.

Wir wachsen – und suchen langfristig jemanden, der die richtigen Menschen für uns findet und sie so behandelt, dass sie auch kommen wollen. Du verantwortest den gesamten Weg von der ersten Ansprache bis zur Vertragsunterschrift.

Aufgaben

Deine Themen bei uns

  • Recruiting: Du besetzt unsere offenen Stellen – erfahrene Consultants, Backoffice-Rollen und Positionen bei GrowInTheRole.
  • Active Sourcing: Du sprichst Kandidat:innen aktiv an, formulierst Stellenanzeigen, die nach uns klingen, und baust einen Talentpool auf.
  • Bewerbermanagement: Eingang, Vorauswahl, Rückmeldungen, Terminkoordination, Absagen und Zusagen – alles in JOIN, und niemand wartet tagelang auf eine Antwort.
  • Auswahlverfahren: Du führst Erstgespräche und bereitest Interviews und Auswahltage mit vor – gemeinsam mit den jeweiligen Hiring Managern: bei Consultant-Stellen die Geschäftsführung, bei Backoffice-Stellen unsere Head of Backoffice, bei GrowInTheRole das dortige Gründungsteam.
  • Rund ums Recruiting: Du pflegst unseren Talentpool und die Kontakte zu Hochschulen, bringst uns als Arbeitgeber auf LinkedIn sichtbar unter und begleitest neue Kolleg:innen bis zum ersten Arbeitstag.
  • KI-Nutzung: Du setzt KI-Tools im Sourcing, Screening und in der Bewerberkommunikation ein – wir probieren gern aus, was funktioniert.
  • Ausstattung: Modernes Notebook und iPhone.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Recruiting-Erfahrung: Du weißt, wie man erfahrene Berater:innen und Backoffice-Kräfte findet und für ein kleines, feines Unternehmen begeistert – und vielleicht hast du auch schon Rollen im Sales oder in der (technischen) Produktentwicklung besetzt.
  • Routine: Du bist mit LinkedIn Recruiter und mit JOIN vertraut (oder einem vergleichbaren Bewerbermanagement-Tool).
  • Selbstorganisation: Du arbeitest eigenständig, priorisierst selbst und hältst, was du zusagst.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr guter sprachlicher Ausdruck auf Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse sind erwünscht.
  • Urteilskraft: Eine fundierte Einschätzung und den Mut, diese zu äußern – wir suchen keine Terminverwaltung, sondern Sparring für die Frage, wer zu uns passt.

Benefits

  • Arbeitszeit: Rund 20 Stunden pro Woche, frei einteilbar – der genaue Umfang ist nach oben wie unten verhandelbar.
  • Homeoffice: Möglich und gelebt. Unser Büro in Greven steht dir offen, Präsenz ist willkommen, aber kein Muss. Aktuell ist ein größerer Standort in Köln geplant.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust unser Recruiting als eigenes Thema auf und entscheidest mit, wie wir Kandidat:innen finden und ansprechen.
  • Teamatmosphäre: Augenhöhe, Transparenz und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche – wir leben, was wir beraten und schaffen ein familiäres Miteinander mit kurzen Wegen und gegenseitiger Unterstützung.
  • Entwicklung: Strukturiertes Onboarding sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Expert:innen für Personalauswahl, Diagnostik und Trainingsformate – du lernst fundierte Auswahlverfahren kennen, führst diagnostische Interviews mit erfahrenen Sparringspartner:innen weiter und baust deine Auswahlkompetenz gezielt aus.

Schick uns Lebenslauf, Anschreiben und Zeugnisse über JOIN – wir melden uns innerhalb weniger Tage.

Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen aller Menschen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Behinderung oder sexueller Identität.

Role Title: Customer Service Expert – Phone Support (LATAM)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Latam remote

Mexico, Central America, Colombia, Peru, Ecuador, Argentina, Chile and Brazil.

micro1 is engaging Customer Service Experts to contribute to a customer’s project, delivering phone-based support across the United States. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. As an independent contractor, you will represent customers during live calls, handling communications with businesses and service providers to complete everyday tasks. This remote engagement prioritizes written and verbal English communication and seeks proactive professionals from LATAM regions.

Scope of Work

  1. Place and receive phone calls on behalf of customers to complete tasks including reservations, appointment scheduling, and vendor confirmations.
  2. Engage with businesses and service providers, ensuring clear, professional communication to gather information and fulfill requests.
  3. Efficiently navigate phone menus, hold queues, and call centers to reach the appropriate contact for each task.
  4. Document outcomes and important details for every call interaction with accuracy and attention to confidentiality.
  5. Handle a high volume of short, consecutive calls addressing a variety of customer needs.
  6. Collaborate with other remote professionals to ensure a consistent, high-quality customer service experience.
  7. Uphold the highest standards of professionalism and discretion with sensitive customer information.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Demonstrated experience in executive assistance, virtual assistance, concierge services, or customer support via phone.
  2. Fluent, neutral, and clear spoken English with strong improvisational and live conversation skills for US-based interactions.
  3. Confidence in making outbound calls, including cold calls, and efficiently navigating automated phone systems.
  4. Reliable high-speed internet connection, quiet work environment, and a quality wired or USB headset.
  5. Experience in the hospitality, restaurant, or travel industries; negotiation or escalation experience is a plus.
  6. Proven ability to work autonomously, manage multiple consecutive tasks, and deliver high-quality service remotely.

Compensation Structure

Representatives are paid for scheduled, available hours — not per call completed.

Start Timeline & Availability

This role requires committed, shift-based availability — representatives must be fully active and responsive for the entire duration of every scheduled shift. This would be an initial 4-week engagement, with representatives working four 5-hour shifts per week (up to 20 hours/week). Genuine weekend availability is required for a portion of the team.

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and expect selected candidates to start their first shifts within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

raw.excerpt: Job DescriptionThe U. S.  Oncology business within our company is a growing and dynamic organization committed to advancing innovative therapies for patients with cancer.
raw.description:
Job Description

The U.S. Oncology business within our company is a growing and dynamic organization committed to advancing innovative therapies for patients with cancer. We have an exciting opportunity to join our dynamic commercial team as we prepare for the potential U.S. launch of an mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy for early-stage melanoma, being developed through an alliance partnership. This novel product has the potential to redefine personalized cancer treatment and requires a highly coordinated operating model to support seamless therapy delivery across a complex treatment ecosystem.

Reporting to the Director, Patient Support Strategy Lead, the Associate Director, Patient Navigator Strategy will serve as the business leader responsible for designing, building, and enabling the INT Patient Navigator capability within the INT Patient Support program. Given the complex nature of individualized neoantigen therapy and the coordination required across multiple stakeholders and treatment milestones, this role will establish the strategic framework for how Patient Navigators engage patients throughout the treatment journey, ensuring a consistent experience from enrollment through treatment completion. The individual will translate patient, provider, and operational insights into scalable capabilities, engagement models, and governance structures that enable effective patient interactions and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

  • Patient Navigator Strategy & Operating Model: Define the Patient Navigator strategy, operating model, service offerings, and engagement framework, establishing navigators as the primary point of contact for patients across the individualized therapy journey.
  • Patient Journey Support Strategy: Define how Patient Navigators support patients across key treatment milestones, providing education, guidance, and non-clinical support to help patients navigate a complex treatment journey.
  • Patient Education Strategy: Establish the strategy for patient education resources, including disease education, treatment journey expectations, manufacturing process information, anticipated timelines, and other non-clinical support materials
  • Patient Engagement Governance: Define consent-capture requirements, approved messaging, support guardrails, escalation pathways, and clinical versus non-clinical support boundaries across all patient-facing navigator interactions.
  • Technology, Data & Digital Enablement: Partner with Data & Technology teams to define technology requirements, CRM capabilities, workflow tools, reporting solutions, and patient visibility capabilities needed to support effective navigator engagement and service delivery.
  • Navigator Performance Management: Establish navigator performance measures, quality standards, service metrics, and reporting requirements. Leverage patient and operational insights to identify trends, barriers, and improvement opportunities that enhance patient experience and program effectiveness.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership & Program Optimization: Partner with Marketing, Patient Support Center of Excellence, End-to-End Therapy Operations, Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and other stakeholders to ensure compliant implementation, operational readiness, and continuous optimization of navigator capabilities.

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (BA/BS)
  • MBA or equivalent preferred

Required Experience and Skills

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare organizations, with experience spanning patient services, patient navigation, patient support programs, care coordination, or related patient-facing functions.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing patient support programs, patient navigation capabilities, or patient engagement models, with a track record of translating patient support strategies into operational programs
  • Experience establishing patient support guardrails, engagement standards, consent requirements, approved messaging, and operational processes that enable compliant patient-facing interactions.
  • Knowledge of patient privacy, informed consent, patient-facing communications, and compliance considerations related to patient support program design and execution
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving capabilities, with a demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, resolve complex operational challenges, and translate strategy into execution.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions and build alignment across a complex matrix organization.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience leading patient navigator, patient support, care coordination, customer experience, nurse educator, or other patient-facing support organizations.
  • Experience supporting the commercialization or launch of advanced therapies, including cell therapy, gene therapy, radioligand therapy, individualized therapies, or other complex treatment modalities.
  • Deep understanding of oncology patient journeys, reimbursement pathways, specialty distribution models, and advanced therapy treatment ecosystems.

Required Skills:

Brand Strategy, Direct Marketing, External Partners, Market Development, Marketing, Marketing Channels, Marketing Program Management, Market Research, Oncology, Patient Assistance, Patient Engagement, Patient Management, Patient Support, Patient Treatment, Product Launch Support, Product Management, Stakeholder Management

Start your journey with BCD: Grow, connect, collaborate and celebrate with our global team

Senior Travel Agent (Remote)

Full time, Spain, Germany, France, Netherlands, Poland

If you live in the Warsaw area, you will need to work in-office for 50% of working time monthly. If you work in the Kraków and Rzeszów areas, you will need to work in-office at least 1 day per week.

As a Senior Travel Consultant, you are the face of our company. You’ll communicate and respond to requests for current and new clients, helping them travel smart and achieve more. Do you communicate effortlessly and have customer service at heart? – Read on!

As a Senior Travel Agent, you will

  • Search and confirm travel reservations for the customer
  • Have a strong understanding of a client travel policy and can consistently provide consultation to the customer
  • Fulfill all requests regarding necessary regulations (DOT, TSA, passports, visas, etc.)
  • Provide the client with the required industry information, such as low fares, exchange costs, and penalties
  • Seek opportunities to review operational processes and commercial relationships with client to provide suggestions for improvement
  • Maintain, actively communicate, and seek expansion of current knowledge of the state of the various travel industries supported

About you

  • Extensive Travel Agent experience
  • Working knowledge of the travel industry, policies, procedures, and processes
  • Advanced skills in GDS Amadeus
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, French, and/or Spainsh

What we offer you

At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe.

About us

BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD’s leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com.

Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media:

You’ll be offered

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities
  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career
  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge
  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools
  • Travel industry professional perks and discounts
  • An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated

At BCD Travel, we value you—our culture and success are defined by our people. We carefully consider a wide range of objective, gender‑neutral compensation factors, including professional background, skills, experience, and role scope.

This position is advertised across multiple European locations. The expected annual gross salary ranges by country are as follows:

  • Spain: 25,000 - 32,000 EUR
  • France: 25,000-35,000 EUR
  • Poland: 84,000-96,000 PLN
  • Germany: 34,000-52,000 EUR
  • Netherlands: 34,000-50,000 EUR

The final salary offered will ultimately depend on the candidate’s qualifications, experience, and location, and will be determined in line with internal equity.

We do not request salary history and are committed to equal pay in line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

Ready to join the journey? Apply now!

We’re dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you’re excited about a role, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply.

We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Testing Tools Development Engineer to design, develop, and maintain advanced testing frameworks and automation tools. This role focuses on building scalable, reusable, and integrated testing infrastructure that supports functional, performance, and security testing across diverse platforms and environments.

.

What you’ll get to do

Tool Development & Framework Design:

  • Strong programming skills in Java with a focus on tooling and automation.
  • Proficiency in extending and customizing open-source tools such as.

  • Strong command of relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) databases, along with experience in publish-subscribe messaging systems like Kafka.

  • Proficient in working within Linux/Unix-based environments, including shell scripting and system-level debugging.
  • Well-versed in Agile/Scrum/Kanban methodologies, with a focus on iterative development and continuous delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability in problem-solving, root cause analysis, and debugging complex systems across the stack.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of working effectively in cross-functional teams.

The Director partners with Executive Leadership, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, Finance, Legal, HRIS, and business leaders to provide compensation guidance, support annual planning, maintain job architecture, assess market competitiveness, support pay equity, and lead compensation-related initiatives. Director, Compensation

your mission

Neptune Software is the AI execution layer for SAP. Enterprises are moving from software that records to software that acts — AI agents running routine work while people govern the exceptions. What stands in the way isn't the models; it's that the logic agents need to act on is locked inside SAP. Neptune runs inside the customer's own landscape and makes that logic executable by AI: agent-ready context, governed tools, and applications where agents act under the customer's own authorizations, with guardrails enforced by the platform — not by the prompt. With Naia, our AI layer, teams build from natural language and deploy agents on ECC today that carry to S/4HANA unchanged, always at Clean Core. SAP-certified, 500+ enterprises, fifteen years in production: we are where core business systems learn to act.

Location

Remote - Spain

The Digital Content Editor (Casual) creates, edits, optimizes and publishes digital copy quickly and cleanly in a fast-paced environment. They will be responsible for ensuring Newsweek delivers timely high-quality reporting that is accurate, fair, and conforms to accepted standards of journalism.

They will have a strong understanding of digital journalism and the needs of a fast-paced newsroom. They will have significant and demonstrable experience in a publishing role at a reputable news organization.

They will work with, edit and publish directly in Newsweek’s CMS (WordPress experience a plus). They will use new tools and technology to create, edit and review content, as required.

This is a casual worker role, working remotely. Shifts are mutually agreed. Work will be offered to you on an “ad-hoc” basis. You are free to accept or decline such offers of work.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Edit copy, headlines, images, captions, graphics and video for accuracy, clarity and impact.

  • Source and prepare relevant images and video, ensuring appropriate verification, rights and credits.
  • Use audience analytics to inform editorial decisions and improve content reach, engagement and performance.
  • Provide feedback and guidance to reporters to improve standards.
  • Work with the social, SEO and multimedia teams to optimize content.
  • Work accurately under pressure and meet tight publishing deadlines.
  • Perform any other reasonable duties necessary to meet the needs of the business.

Qualifications:

  • Significant relevant experience in digital editing and reporting roles.
  • Strong news judgment across a range of subjects.
  • Proven record of editing quickly in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent writing, rewriting and copy-editing skills.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of digital tools or applications including content management systems, SEO, audience analytics and editing assistance software.

Newsweek is an equal opportunity employer. We seek employees of diverse backgrounds and are committed to providing an inclusive, equitable and respectful workplace.

raw.title: Talent Programs Lead
raw.excerpt: Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet.
raw.description:
Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.

Most companies can't tell you why one person is a Senior and another isn't, or what either one should be paid. We're hiring the person who makes Grove able to answer that — and then builds the programs that make the answer real.

The Pitch

  • Grove is rebuilding its leveling guidelines from the ground up. Not adjusting bands — defining what a level actually means, across every function, in a company that looks nothing like it did two years ago. You'll help shape that framework alongside the Director of PX and People Ops leadership, and you'll own getting it out into the company and making it stick.
  • We want comp analysis that arrives with the data already attached. Benchmark the role, build the band, model the offer, show your work. Leaders should be able to act on your recommendation without relitigating it.
  • We want onboarding and talent management that actually connect. A new hire should know what their level means in week one, and their manager should know what growth into the next one looks like.
  • On recruiting: talent acquisition is a small part of this role. You'll run a search when a req opens, and your hiring judgment matters — but reqs are episodic here, and the programs are the job. If you're looking for a full-cycle recruiting seat, this isn't it.
  • The honest version: this is a lot of program surface area for one person, held together by judgment and leverage rather than headcount. That's the trade. You get unusual scope, unusual autonomy, and a direct line to decisions that normally sit two levels up. You don't get a team to hand it to.
  • If you need the process to already exist before you can work, this will be miserable. If you've spent your career being the person who builds the thing that was missing, this is the seat.

What You'd Actually Do

  • Run Grove's compensation analysis (in partnership with Director of People Experience) — benchmark roles against market survey data, build and maintain bands, model offers and internal equity, and bring leaders a recommendation they can act on.
  • Help build Grove's leveling framework and own the rollout: train managers, calibrate real roles against it, answer the hard edge cases, and maintain it as the company changes.
  • Own onboarding end to end, so a new hire's first ninety days are structured, useful, and consistent no matter which team they land on.
  • Administer talent management programs — performance cycles, calibration, career pathing, and development planning — so growth conversations are grounded in the leveling framework instead of vibes.
  • Pick up recruiting when reqs arise — partner with the hiring manager on what the role actually needs, run the search, and hold the bar. A small share of your time, but one where quality is non-negotiable.
  • Use AI as a working instrument, not a novelty — comp benchmarking analysis, JD drafting, onboarding content, program reporting, campaign tracking. A one-person program function only works at this scope if you build it that way.

What You'll Own

Compensation Analysis (primary focus). With guidance from the Director of People Experience, you’ll run market benchmarking, band construction and maintenance, offer and internal-equity modeling, and clear recommendations to leaders. You connect leveling to comp so the two stay honest with each other — scope drives the level, the level drives the band, and you can show your work.

Job Architecture & Leveling. A core contributor to Grove's P-track and T-track leveling framework — scope, impact, autonomy, influence, knowledge, leadership — and the owner of how it lands. That means helping write level language that holds up across functions, calibrating real roles against it, training managers to use it, documenting the edge cases, and keeping it current as the company changes.

Onboarding. Design and own the new-hire experience from offer accept through the first ninety days. Consistent, fast, and specific enough that a new hire knows what their level means and what good looks like in their first month.

Talent Management. The Director of People Experience will own the Talent Management strategy but you’ll own the operating cadence of performance and development — review cycles, calibration sessions, career pathing, and manager enablement. Make the leveling framework the spine of these conversations rather than a document nobody opens.

Talent Acquisition (as needed). Run searches when reqs open. Partner with hiring managers on what the role actually needs before it posts, run a structured process, and be the one who says no when a candidate is good but not good enough. Episodic work, held to a high standard.

Standards and influence. Despite the title, this is an individual contributor role with no direct reports. Your influence shows up as the standards you set: the leveling language managers reach for, the comp reasoning leaders trust, the interview bar people hold because you taught it. You'll advise stakeholders across the company and be believed on the strength of the work.

What You Bring

Read this as a portrait, not a checklist.

  • 6+ years across HR / People programs and talent acquisition, with real depth in both. Not a recruiter who has been adjacent to HR, and not an HR generalist who has never had to defend a band or a level.
  • Compensation fluency. You've worked with market survey data (Radford or equivalent), built or maintained bands, and modeled offers with internal equity in view.
  • Leveling and job architecture experience. You've built, shaped, or operationalized a framework — not just applied someone else's. You know the difference between a level definition and a job description, and why blurring them causes problems eighteen months later.
  • Program ownership. You've run recurring People programs end to end — onboarding, performance cycles, compliance training — and improved them each time rather than just running them again.
  • Recruiting judgment. You can run a search well when one lands, and you know what a high bar looks like and how to assess for it.
  • Experience at a company transforming fast. You've worked where the org chart, the strategy, and the priorities all moved in the same quarter, and you built anyway — iterating in public, shipping a v1, improving it, rather than waiting for the conditions to settle.
  • Demonstrated AI fluency in day-to-day People work. Analysis, drafting, reporting, workflow building. Comfort with tools like Claude or ChatGPT is expected here, not a bonus.
  • Sharp written communication. Much of your influence will be async, in writing, with people who weren't in the room.
  • Serious judgment and discretion. You'll see comp data, leveling decisions, and performance outcomes before most people do, and you'll be trusted with all of it.
  • Based in Pacific or Mountain time. Our People Experience team and most of our corporate leadership operate on West Coast hours, and this role needs real-time overlap.

Bonus Points For

  • Hands-on experience with Radford / Aon compensation data
  • Public company experience, where training and compliance records get looked at closely
  • Experience supporting both corporate and fulfillment or operational populations across multiple states
  • Experience running performance and calibration cycles in an HRIS or talent platform
  • Background in consumer, CPG, e-commerce, or mission-driven organizations
  • Experience building a People function with AI leverage rather than added headcount

Twelve Months From Now…

  • Grove's leveling framework is live, published, and used. Managers reach for it in real decisions instead of asking PX what a title means.
  • Comp recommendations arrive with market data attached and don't get relitigated three times.
  • New hires ramp faster, and they can tell you what their level means and what the next one looks like.
  • Performance and calibration cycles run on a cadence people trust, grounded in the same level language everywhere.
  • When a req does open, it gets a strong process and a strong hire — without the programs slipping while it's live.

One Last Important Note

This isn't a role for someone who wants People programs to be paperwork. It's for someone who thinks how a company levels, pays, onboards, and grows its people is the actual work of building it — and who wants to define how one company does that while that company is in the middle of changing what it is. If that sounds like your kind of hard, let's talk.

What's In It For You

  • This full-time, exempt position is remote for candidates based in the following states: California, Maine, Pennsylvania, Nevada, North Carolina, Texas, Colorado, Washington, Illinois, New York, Missouri, and Massachusetts. Strong preference for candidates based in Pacific or Mountain timezones.
  • Competitive benefits - medical, vision, dental
  • Equity - shared success is core to our mission
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - we care most about results
  • Free VIP membership and 50% employee discount
  • Working for a company that believes that a small group of people can change the world for the better by creating products and funding initiatives that help the planet!

Compensation

The salary range for this role is $105,000-130,000. Our compensation bands are determined based on market-specific cost of living data, meaning that the top of our salary range is reserved for the most experienced candidates in the highest cost of living areas across the country. In addition to the base salary, this role is eligible for an annual incentive target and equity.

MORE ABOUT GROVE

Grove Collaborative Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: GROV) is the one-stop online destination for everyday essentials that create a healthier home and planet. Explore thousands of thoughtfully vetted products for every room and everyone in your home, including household cleaning, personal care, health and wellness, laundry, clean beauty, kitchen, pantry, kids, baby, pet care, and beyond. Everything Grove sells meets a higher standard — from health to sustainability and performance — so you get a great value without compromising your values. As a B Corp and Public Benefit Corporation, Grove goes beyond selling products: every order is carbon neutral, supports plastic waste cleanup initiatives, and lets you see and track the positive impact of your choices. Shopping with purpose starts at .

We're building a diverse and inclusive work environment where we learn from each other. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer.
