  • Technical Product Knowledge Insight and understanding of the Cresta product and configuration methodology in order to help assess & determine the critical path for working teams to overcome roadblocks.
  • Internal Influence and Leadership: Represent the voice of the customer to Cresta’s Executive Team, influencing product direction, go-to-market strategy, and delivery innovation.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 12+ years of experience in enterprise customer delivery, professional services, or program management roles within SaaS, AI, or CX transformation domains.
  • Proven success leading large-scale software deployments for Fortune 500 customers with >$5M in ARR and multiple stakeholder groups.
  • 3+ years of experience managing or mentoring implementation or delivery teams.
  • Deep expertise in executive engagement, enterprise governance, and change management for complex technology programs.
  • Exceptional communication and executive presence — able to influence C-level audiences and synthesize complex technical and business topics with clarity.
  • Strong financial acumen and ability to connect technical outcomes to business value and ROI.
  • Adept at building trusted, long-term relationships across Sales, Customer Success, and Product organizations.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with ambiguity and autonomy.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% for executive engagements and key customer milestones.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience with contact center technology, conversational AI, or analytics platforms strongly preferred.

We offer a comprehensive and people-first benefits package to support you at work and in life:

About Reserv

Reserv is an insurtech creating and incubating cutting-edge AI and automation technology to bring efficiency and simplicity to claims. Founded by insurtech veterans with deep experience in SaaS and digital claims, Reserv is venture-backed by Bain Capital and Altai Ventures and began operations in May 2022. We are focused on automating highly manual tasks to tackle long-standing problems in claims and set a new standard for TPAs, insurance technology providers, and adjusters alike. We have ambitious (but attainable!) goals and need people who can work in an evolving environment. If building a leading TPA and the prospect of tackling the long-standing challenges of the claims role sounds exciting, we can't wait to meet you.

Location Requirement

Candidates must reside in an eligible U.S. state throughout employment. We are unable to hire candidates residing in California, Alaska, Hawaii, U.S. territories, or outside the United States.

About the role

As a Customer Experience Specialist at Reserv, you will be an integral part of our dedicated team focused on providing exceptional service to our customers during the insurance claims process. You will handle phone and email inquiries, provide support, and ensure a smooth and positive experience for all involved parties as they navigate their claims journey. Your expertise in multi-line insurance and claims will enable you to deliver exceptional, empathetic assistance.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customers, providing professional and compassionate assistance throughout the claims process via phone, email, and other communication channels
  • Anticipate the customer needs and take action to manage the process to full resolution
  • Provide guidance and information to customers regarding the claims process, taking any additional steps necessary for the prompt and accurate resolution of their claims
  • Develop and maintain a solid understanding of multi-line claim procedures to provide accurate and consistent information to customers
  • Accurately record and update customer information, claim details, and related documentation in our internal systems, ensuring data integrity and adherence to company protocols
  • Identify and address customer concerns, complaints, and disputes with empathy and professionalism
  • Work collaboratively with internal teams to investigate and resolve complex issues, escalating matters when necessary to achieve timely resolutions
  • Strive to exceed customer expectations by delivering exceptional service, actively listening to customer feedback, and proactively seeking ways to improve the customer experience
  • Adhere to company policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements, ensuring the privacy and confidentiality of customer information at all times

Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent is needed; bachelor's degree or relevant insurance certifications are a plus
  • Previous experience in customer service or a call center environment within the insurance industry, preferably with a focus on property or liability claims; high volume, fast-paced
  • Strong knowledge of multi-line insurance claims processes, terminology, and best practices
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly and empathetically to customers
  • Active listening skills to understand customer needs, concerns, and emotions, and respond appropriately

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!

raw.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Accountant, General Accounting – Cash Reconciliations & Cash Operations is responsible for performing and supporting enterprise cash reconciliation processes while contributing to initiatives that impact cash activities across key functions, including Accounts Payable (AP), premium receipts, claims disbursements, and related operations. This role ensures the accurate, timely, and well-controlled reconciliation of cash-related accounts while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen financial controls, enhance operational effectiveness, and drive continuous improvement.

Reporting to the Associate Director of General Accounting, you will lead and support initiatives involving process optimization, system enhancements, implementations, integrations, automation, and policy updates that improve cash operations across the organization.

Main Responsibilities

  • Contribute to month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities related to cash and balance sheet accounts.
  • Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, investigating and resolving outstanding items promptly.
  • Lead and support accounting and cash operations initiatives, including process improvements, system enhancements, implementations, integrations, automation efforts, policy updates, and organizational change management activities.
  • Develop project plans, manage timelines, coordinate stakeholders, and drive accountability for project deliverables
  • Reconcile high-volume cash activity, including:
    • Accounts Payable disbursements
    • Premium billing and cash receipts
    • Claims payments and related clearing accounts
  • Monitor aged reconciling items and escalate issues to management.
  • Partner with teams, including AP, Billing, Claims, Treasury, and IT, to research discrepancies and improve cash-related processes.
  • Support process improvement projects focused on automation, standardization, and enhanced reporting dashboards.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, Model Audit Rule (MAR) requirements, and audit readiness expectations.
  • Prepare reconciliation documentation and support internal and external audit requests.
  • Develop and maintain reports and dashboards that provide visibility into reconciliation status, exceptions, and important cash metrics.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of progressive accounting, reconciliation, or financial reporting experience
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing complex balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Experience with month end close
  • Experience supporting process improvement and automation projects.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency with accounting systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPA, CPA candidate, or equivalent professional certification.
  • Cash account reconciliation experience.
  • Experience working with large data sets
  • Experience with BlackLine, Power BI, or similar financial reporting and reconciliation tools.
  • Experience leading process improvement, automation, or system implementation projects.
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance, or managed care environments
  • Knowledge of premium billing, claims payment cycles, treasury operations, or cash management processes.
  • Cash account reconciliation experience
  • Experience with BlackLine, Power BI, or similar financial reporting and reconciliation tools.

Join Think Academy as a full-time Math Teacher. Teach with a structured, high-quality curriculum, receive paid training, and grow into long-term teaching and curriculum roles. This is a long-term teaching opportunity — not a short-term tutoring role.

About Think Academy

Think Academy US, a wholly owned subsidiary of TAL Education Group (NYSE: TAL), is a leading education company dedicated to helping K–12 students build strong academic foundations, confidence in math, and long-term learning ability through high-quality teaching and thoughtfully designed curriculum.

Why This Role Is Different

Most teaching roles expect you to build everything yourself. Here, you teach within a structured instructional system — curriculum, lesson materials, training, and team support are already in place, so you can focus on teaching quality and student growth instead of building materials from scratch.

  • Stronger Teaching Support — high-quality curriculum and lesson materials, structured onboarding, ongoing training, and a team to collaborate with instead of teaching in isolation
  • Long-Term Career Growth — high performers can grow into Senior Teacher, Teacher Trainer, or Academic Operations/Management roles
  • Competitive, Growing Earnings — paid for both teaching and non-teaching work, with performance-based raises up to 3 times a year, and an end-of-semester commission

What You'll Do

  • Teach math (up to Pre-Algebra) in a clear, engaging, student-centered way, using our curriculum, lesson materials, and instructional guidance
  • Lead virtual classes with ~18 students, creating a positive, high-expectation learning environment
  • Grade homework, give timely feedback, and communicate professionally with students/parents on progress and learning plans
  • Participate in training, lesson prep, and ongoing professional development

Schedule & Commitment

  • ~3-6 classes/week (6-12 teaching hours), plus admin hours (grading, prep, parent comms) — total 30-40 hrs/week
  • Class windows (Pacific Time): Wed-Fri, 4pm-8pm and Sat-Sun, 9am-8pm
  • Once classes are assigned, your schedule stays consistent week to week (except federal holidays)
  • We are looking for candidates who can commit to at least one year consistent teaching schedule

Compensation & Benefits

  • Teaching Hours: $35-45/hour
  • Non-Teaching/Admin Hours: $16-20/hour (grading, class prep, parent communication)
  • Performance-based pay increases up to 3 times per year, plus end-of-semester commission targeted at 15-30% of total teaching compensation
  • Qualified teachers may be assigned more long-term classes, or have expanded responsibilities
  • Benefits: 401(k), health/dental/vision insurance (based on eligibility)
  • Visa sponsorship may be considered for long-term, high-performing teachers

Who We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited college or university
  • Strong math foundation, comfortable with Pre-Algebra or above; Math, STEM-related, or Education majors preferred
  • Available during the class windows above; available on at least one weekend day
  • Passion for teaching and supporting student growth; strong communication skills
  • Strong service mindset: proactive, comfortable initiating communication with parents, students, and the team, not just delivering lessons
  • Open to feedback, self-reflective, and able to quickly adjust your teaching and service approach
  • Tutoring, mentoring, coaching, or classroom teaching experience is a plus
  • Math competition background (e.g., AMC, Math Kangaroo) is a plus

Think Academy is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status, and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

CSC Generation is the AI-native holding company re-engineering omnichannel retail. We acquire iconic brands and transform them with Genesis, our operating platform combining a Data Fabric, Automation Engine, proprietary tools, and shared services to modernize operations, elevate customer experience, and expand margins. With $1B+ in revenue across 13 brands, our portfolio includes Sur La Table, Backcountry, One Kings Lane, and others that serve as real-world innovation labs.

Reports to: Chief Administrative Officer

Location: Remote (US or Canada), with regular collaboration across CSC Generation brands

About the Role

    This role exists to find and close executive, strategic, and highly specialized hires across CSC Generation's portfolio — the kind of searches where the right candidate is passive, hard to find, and being courted by everyone else. As Executive & Strategic Recruiter, you will own end-to-end search strategy and execution, partnering directly with hiring executives to define roles, map talent, and close candidates who weren't looking.

    In the first 6–12 months, success means you have personally sourced and closed multiple senior-level searches, built a warm pipeline of high-value passive candidates, and established yourself as a trusted advisor to hiring executives across the portfolio.

    This is a lean team. You will own a lot, move fast, and make decisions with full end-to-end responsibility.

What You'll Do

  • Own end-to-end search strategy and execution for executive, strategic, and hard-to-fill roles across CSC Generation's portfolio brands and shared services, including sourcing approach, assessment criteria, and offer strategy in partnership with hiring executives.
  • Proactively source passive candidates through direct outreach, competitive talent mapping, referral networks, and platforms like LinkedIn — going well beyond inbound applicant flow.
  • Partner directly with hiring executives to define hard-to-articulate role profiles and translate them into actionable sourcing strategies.
  • Close searches where the ideal candidate profile is narrow, such as roles requiring deep applied AI or data science experience.
  • Build and maintain relationships with high-value passive candidates over time, even when there is no open role, so the pipeline is warm when the need arises.
  • Manage confidential searches with judgment and discretion, including roles tied to organizational restructuring or leadership transitions.
  • Provide market intelligence on talent availability and competitive hiring activity to inform how and where CSC Generation competes for talent.

Required Qualifications

  • Demonstrated track record of sourcing and closing passive candidates for hard-to-fill executive or specialized roles — not just managing inbound pipelines. You have personally sourced and closed 10–15 or more senior-level searches in the last 12 months.
  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy, ambiguity, and direct executive access as an individual contributor.
  • A genuine network and the instincts to know who to call, not just how to run a search.
  • Technical fluency with modern AI and automation tools, with demonstrated ability to use these tools to increase effectiveness and productivity while exercising judgment about where human review is required in candidate evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Search firm or agency recruiting background — you know how to cold-approach someone who wasn't looking and make them interested in speaking with you.
  • Experience recruiting technical, data science, or AI talent, given CSC Generation's AI-first operating model.
  • Retail, e-commerce, or multi-brand holding company experience.

Why Join

    The people who do best here are builders. They take ownership, move fast, and want to see the direct impact of their work.

  • Cross-Functional Impact: Your work touches every brand and function in the portfolio. Every search you close directly shapes the leadership and capabilities of CSC Generation.
  • AI-First Skill Building: You will operate inside an AI-native company that expects you to leverage modern tools and continuously sharpen how you source, evaluate, and close talent.
  • End-to-End Ownership: You own your searches from intake through close — no handoffs, no committees. You set the strategy, run the process, and deliver the hire.
  • Competitive Benefits (US): Paid time off policies, 401(k) match, medical/dental/vision and a variety of supplemental policies, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.
  • Competitive Benefits (Canada): Paid time off policies, RRSP match, medical, dental, and vision coverage, a variety of supplemental benefit options, and employee discounts across our portfolio of brands.

Interview Process

    1. Recruiter Screen - A 30-minute conversation with our recruiting team to align on the role, your background, and what you are looking for.
    2. Hiring Manager Interview - Conversation with the Chief Administrative Officer focused on your search approach, sourcing methodology, and how you close passive candidates at the executive level.
    3. In-Person Interview - We'd like to meet you at one of our office hubs (Salt Lake City, Austin, or Toronto). Details and logistics will be arranged with your recruiter.

    5. Offer - We move quickly for the right candidate.

raw.title: Senior Product Manager - 12 Month FTC

raw.description:
This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 12 month FTC.

Role Summary

PLOS is a nonprofit Open Access publisher with an ambitious mission: to help transform research communication so that science can be shared, understood and used more effectively. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Product team for a 12-month maternity cover contract.It's an interesting time to join us.

Research publishing is changing rapidly. Researchers' expectations are changing. Technology is creating possibilities that didn't exist a few years ago. And at PLOS we're rethinking some of the services, systems and assumptions that have shaped scholarly publishing for decades.

That means there are interesting product problems to solve - not just features to deliver.

You'll take responsibility for a product area and work with designers, engineers and colleagues across PLOS to understand the problems that matter, work out where we can make the greatest difference and help the team learn its way towards good solutions.

Although this is a fixed-term role, it isn't a caretaker role. You'll be joining active product teams working on significant problems and will have plenty of opportunity to shape what we do and how we do it.

How we work

We want our product teams to be curious, evidence-led and comfortable with uncertainty.

We don't expect a Product Manager to arrive with all the answers. We do expect them to ask good questions.

You'll use continuous discovery alongside delivery: spending time with users, looking at data, understanding the wider service, identifying assumptions and finding practical ways to test them.

You'll help the team break large problems into smaller things we can learn from, rather than waiting until everything is known before we release something.

And you'll make the team's thinking visible - explaining what we're trying to achieve, what we've learned, what we're uncertain about and why we're making the choices we are.

Responsibilities

As a Senior Product Manager, you'll:

  • Understand the problem. Build a deep understanding of our users, their needs and behaviours, as well as the organisational, operational and technical context surrounding them.
  • Shape product direction. Work out where the greatest opportunities lie within your area and help translate PLOS's objectives into clear product outcomes and priorities.
  • Practise continuous discovery. Work closely with design, engineering and others to explore problems, identify assumptions and regularly test ideas with users and through data.
  • Turn uncertainty into learning. Frame hypotheses, design useful experiments and look for the smallest sensible way to learn whether we're heading in the right direction.
  • Make good product decisions. Weigh evidence, impact, effort, risk and opportunity when deciding what to pursue - and what not to pursue.
  • Measure whether things are getting better. Define useful measures of success and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to understand whether our work is having the intended effect.
  • Work iteratively. Help the team deliver in small steps, learn from what happens and adapt rather than treating plans as fixed commitments.
  • Communicate your thinking. Clearly explain problems, evidence, choices, trade-offs and learning to people with very different levels of technical and product knowledge.
  • Create strong feedback loops. Use conversations, demos, reviews and other forums to get useful feedback early rather than presenting finished thinking late.
  • Work as part of a team. Create the conditions in which designers, engineers and other specialists can contribute to product decisions rather than treating product management as something the PM does alone.
  • Look beyond the product interface. Understand the wider service, including processes, systems and teams around it, and recognise when solving a user problem requires changing more than software.

Experience and qualifications

Essential

  • Degree-level qualification or equivalent professional experience. 
  • At least three years' experience working as a Product Manager in a multidisciplinary digital product team, working closely with disciplines such as design, engineering, research and delivery.
  • Experience using product discovery alongside delivery - for example, user research, data, experimentation and hypothesis testing - to understand problems and inform what a team should do next.
  • Experience working with significant uncertainty or ambiguity: identifying what is known, what is assumed and what needs to be learned before making larger commitments.
  • Experience taking complex problems and helping a team turn them into clear priorities, outcomes and practical next steps.
  • Experience making product decisions using a combination of user evidence, data, organisational goals, technical constraints and product judgement.
  • Experience communicating product thinking clearly to a wide range of people, including explaining evidence, uncertainty, trade-offs and why particular decisions have been made.
  • Experience working collaboratively with people outside the immediate product team, particularly where different groups have different needs, incentives or perspectives.

Particularly useful

We'd be especially interested in candidates who have experience of one or more of the following:

  • Working in an organisation going through significant product, digital or organisational transformation.
  • Working in complex service environments where improving the user experience involves changes to technology, operations, policy or organisational processes - not simply changing an interface.
  • Helping teams move towards more iterative, outcome-focused or evidence-led ways of working.
  • Working in a mission-led, research, publishing, education, scientific or other knowledge-based organisation.

Experience of scholarly publishing is useful but isn't required.

What we're looking for in a Senior Product Manager

For us, seniority isn't about having a larger backlog or knowing more product framework: it's about judgement.

You'll be able to take a complex and uncertain problem, help people understand it, decide what we most need to learn, bring a team together around a sensible course of action and change that course when the evidence tells us to.

You'll be comfortable making decisions without perfect information while being clear about the assumptions and risks involved.

And you'll help the people around you think more clearly about the product - not simply tell them what to build.

Working at PLOS

You'll join PLOS's Product team and work collaboratively with colleagues across Digital and the wider organisation.

The role has no direct line-management responsibility.

The job is fully remote. Some flexibility to work across time zones and occasional national or international travel may be required.

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (UK) £65,000 - £75,500. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below.

BENEFITS:

  • Private medical insurance
  • Life assurance
  • Income protection 
  • Personal accident insurance
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out.

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all.

Visit to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

raw.title: Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning Engineer
raw.excerpt: We are hiring a Software Engineer in the Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning job family to join our Enterprise AI Platform team in Israel.
raw.description:
We are hiring a Software Engineer in the Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning job family to join our Enterprise AI Platform team in Israel.

The platform powers AI-assisted engineering workflows across Sandisk and is built on a hybrid on-prem and cloud architecture with agentic orchestration, an MCP ecosystem, an LLM gateway, and memory and knowledge layers. This role focuses on the AI harness: the platform's agentic command-line tooling and the framework of skills, tools, memory, and guardrails that turn a general-purpose model into a governed engineering agent.

As part of the role, you will build distributed software systems and apply them to the runtime, integrations, and evaluation loops that make AI agents reliable inside Sandisk's engineering environment. You will work closely with platform engineers in the US and India and with the firmware, validation, and lab teams in Israel who use the harness every day.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:
Harness Development: Build and extend the platform's agentic harness, including the CLI runtime, the framework of skills and tool definitions, context and memory management, sandboxing, and execution hooks that govern what an agent is allowed to do.

Distributed Systems: Design and implement the services behind the harness: gateway integrations, session and state management, job execution, caching, and the secure paths that connect developer machines to on-prem platform services.

AI Ecosystem Contribution: Develop MCP servers, skills, and integrations that expose engineering data and tools (Jira, test management, lab benches, internal systems) to agents in a governed way. Contribute reusable components back to the shared platform framework.

Applied AI Understanding: Use working knowledge of how LLM-based systems behave in practice, including tool calling, context windows, prompt and skill design, token cost, failure modes, and evaluation, to make agent workflows predictable and cost-aware.

Reliability & Observability: Instrument harness components with tracing, metrics, and evaluation pipelines. Debug agent behavior end-to-end across the CLI, gateway, and model layers. Participate in incident response and postmortems.

Engineering Quality: Write well-tested, maintainable code. Build automated tests and evaluation suites for agent behavior. Take part in code and design reviews.

Local Partnership: Act as the platform's engineering presence in Israel. Gather requirements from teams adopting the harness, support early users, and feed learnings back into the roadmap.

Continuous Learning: Track advances in agent frameworks, coding agents, MCP, and AI infrastructure, and bring practical improvements into the harness.

Required:
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

2 to 3 years of professional software engineering experience building and operating backend or distributed systems in production.

Strong proficiency in Python; working knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript. Hands-on experience designing services, REST or GraphQL APIs, asynchronous and event-driven systems, and reliable client-server communication.

Practical understanding of how modern AI systems work: LLM APIs, tool and function calling, context and memory management, RAG, embeddings, and evaluation. Able to explain why an agent failed, not only that it did.

Experience with, or demonstrated interest in, agentic frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph, LangChain, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

Experience with Docker and containerized deployments; exposure to Kubernetes and hybrid on-prem and cloud environments.

Working knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL), in-memory stores (Redis / Valkey), and vector databases.

Familiarity with enterprise security and identity basics: OAuth, OIDC, SSO, and secrets handling.

Comfortable in Linux and terminal-centric development workflows, including Git and CI/CD.

Preferred:
Bachelor's degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, or a related field.

Experience using and extending AI coding agents or agentic CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, or similar) beyond basic usage: custom tools, skills, hooks, or MCP servers.

Familiarity with at least one systems language (Go, Rust, Java, or C++).

Exposure to embedded, firmware, or storage-systems engineering, or to lab automation and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

Contributions to open-source AI tooling, or a portfolio of agent-based projects.

Experience with observability and evaluation tooling for LLM applications (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Grafana, or similar).

Clear written communication and the ability to work across time zones with distributed teams.

Curiosity, pragmatism, and a habit of delivering small, tested increments.

raw.title: UX Designer
raw.excerpt: At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health.
raw.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced UX Designerto join our Product team. In this role, you will partner closely with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineering to design new features and funnels, as well as evolve existing customer-facing product lines across all platforms. You'll bring thoughtful, user-centered thinking to projects ranging from focused feature work to end-to-end flows, reporting into our Director of UX. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Design end-to-end user experiences across web, iOS, and Android — from early concept and user flows through wireframes, prototypes, and production-ready design files
  • Partner with Product Managers and Engineering to scope, design, and ship new features and funnels, as well as improvements to existing customer-facing product lines
  • Design and support conversion and growth experiments (e.g., onboarding, sign-up, and checkout flows) as well as features that drive engagement and retention and reduce churn
  • Create wireframes, interactive prototypes, and high-fidelity mockups in Figma, and maintain organized, up-to-date design files and documentation
  • Contribute to and help evolve Talkspace's design system, ensuring consistency and reusability across platforms
  • Support and help execute user research and usability testing; translate findings and data-driven insights into concrete design decisions
  • Apply accessibility and platform-specific best practices (iOS, Android, Web) to ensure designs are intuitive, inclusive, and technically feasible
  • Incorporate motion, audio, and animation thoughtfully where they improve the user experience
  • Present design rationale and recommendations clearly to cross-functional stakeholders, incorporating feedback and building consensus
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Data/Analytics, and Brand to ensure designs are aligned, technically sound, and on-brand
  • Stay current on UX, interaction design, and visual design trends, bringing fresh thinking to the team

About You

  • 4+ years of experience as a UX Designer creating digital-first products (iOS, Android, and web), ideally in mass-market digital consumer products/apps, subscription-based, or e-commerce. Prior experience with digital healthcare/behavioral health is a plus
  • Experience designing a variety of project types and features, including but not limited to: conversion and growth experiments, and consumer-focused features that drive engagement, retention, and reduce churn
  • Experience supporting or executing user research and usability testing, and translating findings into actionable design decisions
  • Solid understanding of iOS, Android, and Web standard UX/UI practices
  • Strong proficiency in Figma (Sketch a plus)

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • Flexible PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $100,000 - $150,000. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

About Versapay 🚀

Versapay turns accounts receivable (AR) into a competitive advantage.
Inefficient AR processes slow cash flow and stall growth. Versapay removes friction, unlocks working capital, and accelerates momentum — giving finance leaders the clarity and control they need to drive business forward.
Versapay automates accounts receivable, removing barriers to collecting and reconciling B2B payments. Our solutions connect finance teams, customers, and business systems in one ecosystem to ensure cash flow clarity. With over 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting on the platform, Versapay processes over 110M transactions and $257B annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!
How you’ll make a big impact here – and on your career:
As a Senior Product Manager on the Versapay AR Automation team, you will act as the single accountable owner for a critical product area, responsible for delivering measurable business outcomes—not just features. You will lead the evolution of our AR platform into an AI-first, highly automated, and scalable system that drives meaningful improvements in cash flow, efficiency, and customer experience.

You will operate as a GM for your domain, owning strategy, execution, and commercial success. This includes defining what we build and why, validating opportunities through experimentation, and ensuring successful adoption and performance post-launch.

  • Own measurable business outcomes (adoption, revenue, unit economics, retention) and adjust strategy based on performance signals.
  • Act as the single accountable owner for your product area, making decisions based on data, customer insight, and strategy—not stakeholder opinion.
  • Operate with an AI-first mindset—leveraging AI across discovery, prototyping, and product capabilities.
  • Define and evolve product strategy with clear narratives, including customer problem, expected impact, assumptions, and risks.
  • Own or influence product economics, including revenue performance, cost-to-serve, and monetization strategy.
  • Drive end-to-end product lifecycle from discovery through commercialization, ensuring delivery translates into real business impact.
  • Design and run structured experiments (concept tests, pilots, pricing tests) to validate opportunities before scaling.
  • Continuously modernize your product, improving architecture, reducing technical debt, and adopting new technologies.
  • Apply systems thinking to design scalable, end-to-end customer journeys across workflows, data, and platform components.
  • Own go-to-market outcomes end to end, including positioning, enablement, adoption, and commercial success.
  • Partner cross-functionally to drive alignment, influence decisions, and operationalize product changes.
  • Drive towards self-serve, scalable product experiences that reduce operational friction.
  • Synthesize customer insight, product data, and market signals to continuously refine priorities.
  • Lead through influence in a complex environment, making clear decisions under ambiguity.
  • Create clarity through strong written artifacts, decision frameworks, and communication.
  • Foster a high-performance, low-ego culture grounded in accountability and collaboration.

What You'll Bring To The Team:

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, preferably in B2B, fintech, or payments.
  • Proven track record of owning and delivering measurable product outcomes.
  • Experience building and scaling complex products, platforms, or APIs.
  • Experience launching AI/ML products or features.
  • Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate data into decisions.
  • Experience designing and running experiments to validate product direction.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with a bias toward action.
  • Strong technical fluency and ability to partner deeply with engineering.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including executive audiences.
  • Passion for customer problems and delivering meaningful, measurable value.

What Will Make You Stand Out (Nice to Have):

  • Experience with AR, payments, or financial workflow automation.
  • Experience applying AI/ML to product development or product capabilities.
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with the ability to design scalable solutions.
  • Experience influencing pricing, packaging, or go-to-market strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with product analytics or data tooling.

Supporting Your Well-being

We provide services across the Enterprise Technology Stack for business process outsourcing, insurance, analytics and engineering, applications, security, cloud, IT outsourcing, and modern workplace.

Our DXC Insurance Services help our customers optimize and transform operations, lower costs, increase agile new channels to growth. Our people, technology and best practices improve and automate highly complex business processes middle and back offices- while facilitating customer experience transformation.

Essential Job Functions

The Project Manager plans, coordinates, and oversees customer-facing software implementation, migration, and custom projects. This includes preparing customer kickoff materials, developing and maintaining milestone plans, coordinating resource requests, tracking project financials, managing invoices, facilitating regular project meetings, documenting meeting minutes, monitoring risks and issues, and ensuring clear communication across all stakeholders.

  • Manage multiple customer projects concurrently, ensuring scope, schedule, budget, quality, and customer expectations are effectively controlled.

  • Develop, maintain, and communicate project milestone plans, schedules, status updates, meeting minutes, action items, and project documentation.

  • Own and track forecasts, actuals, revenue, billing, project hours, invoices, and other financial measures to support accurate project reporting and contract compliance.

  • Identify, document, and manage project risks, issues, dependencies, and constraints; recommend and implement mitigation plans as appropriate.

  • Monitor and identify potential scope changes or scope creep; coordinate change control activities when additional work or revised requirements are identified.

  • Coordinate with internal teams, technical resources, customers, and stakeholders to manage business requirements, technical requirements, schedules, and deliverables.

  • Facilitate customer and internal project meetings, ensuring decisions, action items, risks, and follow-ups are clearly documented and communicated.

  • Oversee assigned project team activities by providing direction, clarifying priorities, tracking progress, and ensuring deadlines and objectives are understood.

  • Support continuous improvement by contributing to new procedures, templates, and process enhancements that improve delivery consistency and customer outcomes.

Basic Qualifications

  • Five or more years of project management experience, preferably managing multiple small to mid-sized customer software projects concurrently without dedicated project teams.

  • Experience executing projects in MS Project and MS Excel.

  • Experience managing software implementation, upgrade, migration, or IT delivery projects through the full project lifecycle.

  • Strong knowledge of project management practices, including project planning, budget tracking, forecasting, risk management, issue management, change control, quality assurance, and delivery governance.

  • Experience working with customer business objectives, critical success factors, contractual requirements, and project performance measures.

  • Experience working within a software development or implementation lifecycle, including requirements, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, and transition to support.

Other Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly with customers, project teams, leadership, and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage many active projects, competing priorities, and frequent context switching.

  • High attention to detail, particularly in meeting minutes, project tracking, financial reporting, invoice approvals, issue follow-up, and risk documentation.

  • Ability to anticipate issues, recommend practical solutions, and drive follow-through to resolution.

  • Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build trust, manage expectations, and support successful project outcomes.

  • Experience with insurance, claims software, or claims administration is preferred.

  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and contribute to process, template, and procedural improvements.

  • Willingness to work outside standard business hours when required to support project needs or customer commitments.

  • May require occasional travel.

Job Title: Accounting Sales Executive

Base Salary: $100,000 per year
Expected Total Cash Compensation Range: $140,000 - $160,000 per year
Bonus Eligibility: Yes, incentive bonuses included in the Total Cash Compensation above
ABOUT THIS OPPORTUNITY:
Kruze Consulting provides accounting, bookkeeping, finance, payroll, and tax services to over 750 startups backed by top tier venture capital funds. The AccountingSales Executive is the first point of contact for prospective clients who have requested information about accounting, tax, and financial services for their venture-backed startup. You will conduct introductory calls and prepare service quotes based on each prospect’s current and projected needs as they grow.

This role is built for someone who understands accounting and finance and wants to put that knowledge to work in a client-facing, commercial role. If you have spent time in accounting, bookkeeping, tax, or an outsourced finance function, and you find you enjoy the client conversations more than the compliance deadlines, this is a way to use your expertise every day without month-end close or busy season. Your credibility with founders will come from genuinely knowing the work, not from a script.

The ideal candidate is a natural relationship builder, an excellent communicator, highly organized, and detail-oriented. Kruze Consulting has a proven track record of developing its people to their highest potential. If you want to grow in a consultative, revenue-facing role at an entrepreneurial, fully remote professional services
firm, this is a terrific opportunity to do it.
KRUZE CONSULTING IS AN EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER.
Kruze Consulting believes in diversity of thought as a competitive advantage to bring people together to build a culturally inclusive team. If you are smart, and good at what you do, come as you are. Diverse candidates (however you choose or choose not to identify) are encouraged to apply.
WHAT WE OFFER/WHY KRUZE CONSULTING:
  • Fully Remote – We’ve completely embraced and invested in remote work and know the benefits. Save time, save money, and decrease stress. Our experience shows that remote work fosters a healthier work/life balance for our people. We do get together once a year for an annual offsite meeting, but in-person attendance is optional.
  • Flexibility/Autonomy - Need to run to an appointment, your child's school, or just want to take a walk outside? No problem. If your clients’ needs are met and your work gets done on time, enjoy!
  • Stability – While we serve startups, we aren’t one. We’ve been around for almost a decade enjoying controlled growth over that time. We don’t over-hire, and thankfully, we’ve never had to do a reduction in force. Our service offering is niche, accounting is essential to businesses, and the potential market for our services is diversified/vast.
  • High-Quality Colleagues - We’re a diverse bunch, experts in our respective fields, and eager to help each other and clients. We care about each other as whole human beings.
  • High-Quality Clients - We work exclusively with venture-funded technology startups and early-stage companies who are creating some of the most exciting and transformative products and services in the world! (We also have a “no jerks” policy; our clients treat our people professionally and respectfully.)
  • Purpose/Meaningful Work – This is not your average accounting role. Kruze professionals get to work with innovative startups that are disrupting their respective industries and creating the products and services of tomorrow. Like proud parents, we derive vicarious enjoyment as our clients grow, get additional rounds of funding, and ultimately get acquired by Fortune 500 firms.
  • Professional Development – You’ll gain exposure to many types of clients and industries including SaaS, eCommerce, Healthcare, Biotech, Crypto/Blockchain, and Manufacturing. At Kruze, you’ll have the opportunity to learn multiple disciplines and work with a wide variety of high-visibility clients and find your passion.

NEED TO HAVE/POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

  • A background in accounting or finance. We are looking for hands-on experience in accounting, bookkeeping, tax, or an outsourced finance function. A bachelor’s degree with a major in accounting also qualifies. What matters is that you can speak about a startup’s books, taxes, and financial operations with the fluency and accuracy Kruze is known for.
    ·Experience in a client-facing role such as sales, business development, or client advisory. A direct sales background is a plus, not a requirement. If you bring the accounting knowledge and a natural ability with people, we are glad to train the sales side.
  • Must be willing to work core business hours in their local time zone (approximately 8am to 5pm local time within the U.S.)

NICE TO HAVE/POSITION PREFERENCES:

  • Experience in a consulting or outsourced bookkeeping/accounting firm
  • Experience selling accounting or professional services to business leaders
  • Experience in an enterprise SaaS company
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM
  • A general understanding of the corporate tax filing process
  • Experience working with early-stage VC-backed startups
WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:
Sales (85% of the time, primarily inbound, outbound as needed)
  • Achieve and consistently exceed sales goals by closing new business
  • Educate and guide prospective customers through their buyer’s journey, helping them understand how Kruze can support their growth as a partner on the finance and tax side of the business
  • Monitor and nurture inbound leads with timely follow-ups, and actively reach out to set up introductory calls
  • Own the details of Kruze’s financial service offerings and speak to them with confidence
  • Advise startup founders and operators on accounting and finance problems, and actively recommend solutions
Administrative (10% of the time)
  • Provide updates to the Sales leadership on the sales pipeline and other key metrics
  • Maintain and update records, notes, and details within Salesforce for leads, opportunities, and accounts
  • Work cross-functionally with our Onboarding, Tax, Accounting, and finance teams, echoing the voice of the customer and providing constructive, actionable feedback
  • Collaborate with Sales and Marketing to refine the sales playbook, run tests, and experiment with new approaches and processes
Internal collaboration and professional development (5% of the time)
·Attend internal meetings, training sessions, and team planning sessions
·Cross-train and collaborate to build business acumen across Kruze’s services and clients
·Engage in ongoing professional development appropriate to the role and Kruze’s evolving needs
  • And any other duties and tasks to support business needs as directed by management
A note of caution about remote work at Kruze Consulting:
While it seems cool, it’s not for everyone. You must have the discipline, work ethic, healthy boundaries, work strategies, and emotional intelligence to work remotely. While we strive for work-life balance at Kruze, this is still a fast-paced role that will require you to juggle many different projects and tasks. You must enjoy and thrive in this type of fast-paced environment.
About Kruze Consulting:
Kruze Consulting provides accounting, bookkeeping, finance, payroll, and tax services to over 750 startups backed by top tier venture capital funds.
  • Our core values are: Kaizen ∙ Integrity ∙ Innovation ∙ Collaborative ∙ Caring ∙ Strategic
We are a 100% remote company, working in many different countries and time zones; we encourage our employees to take advantage of our flexible work environment to be happier and more productive. The firm has 750+ Seed, Series A, Series B, and Series C clients. The firm was started 15 years ago, by Vanessa Kruze, CPA and now has 150+ team members. Kruze utilizes best-of-breed software tools such as QuickBooks, Gusto, Justworks, Rippling, Expensify, , Zoom, Slack, Ramp, and Brex. Our client base is comprised of venture capital-backed startups funded by the very best venture capital funds in the world.
Physical Requirements:
Extended periods of focused, seated computer work – approximately 8 hours a day

After making a conditional offer and running a background check, if Kruze is concerned about conviction that is directly related to the job, you will be given the chance to explain the circumstances surrounding the conviction, provide mitigating evidence, or challenge the accuracy of the background report. This role combines the transaction-level judgment of a seasoned underwriter with the data and process orientation of a credit analytics specialist, and may include mentoring or providing working guidance to junior credit analysts as part of day-to-day deal flow.
Job Responsibilities
  • Review, evaluate, and adjudicate a high volume of daily commercial credit submissions, including financial statement analysis, collateral evaluation, and business history review
  • Recommend appropriate risk-based pricing and deal structure; direct, coordinate, and make recommendations for lease approvals
  • Conduct background investigation including bank, finance company, and trade references, and confirmation of revenue sources
  • Identify transactions to be funded via Beacon's portfolio or third-party funding partners, and manage a pipeline of “in credit” transactions in a timely manner
  • Assist in the underwriting of portfolio acquisitions and/or portfolio sales
  • Maintain working familiarity with Beacon's core industry assets and business borrowers
  • Manage and grow relationships with Beacon's syndicate bank and funding partners
  • Negotiate improved financing terms and conditions with syndication and funding partners
  • Identify and establish new syndication bank programs and funding partnerships
  • Assist in the development and ongoing enhancement of corporate credit scoring strategy and credit policy manual
  • Build and maintain dashboards, alerts, and visualization tools (e.g., Tableau) to monitor key credit and portfolio performance indicators
  • Independently research and recommend asset classes, credit tools, systems, and data sources to improve underwriting and support new business generation
  • Analyze credit data and portfolio performance to identify underwriting trends, risks, and opportunities, and translate findings into clearly defined, implementable strategies and rules
  • Maintain credit standards and monitor industry regulations, requirements, trends, and competitor activity to ensure ongoing compliance
  • Present credit analytics findings and recommendations to senior management, and work closely with executives on credit policy and credit decisions
  • Effectively communicate with sales staff to facilitate deal flow, and assist in establishing payment terms and procedures with new vendor referral relationships
  • Collaborate with data analysts and application developers to build, fix, and enhance credit underwriting technology and reporting platforms
  • Foster effective teamwork across credit, sales, accounting, documentation, and collections
  • Provide working guidance and mentorship to junior credit analysts as needed; contribute to a positive, collaborative team environment
  • Participate in project management alongside cross-functional business partners on new initiatives, prioritization, and delivery
Job Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, business, or a related field
  • 5+ years of combined experience in credit underwriting, portfolio management, and/or credit analytics, ideally with a bank, finance company, or leasing company
  • Business and/or four (4) year college degree is preferred
  • Experience with small-ticket, construction, and/or commercial vehicle equipment finance is a plus
  • Advanced knowledge of loans, leasing, credit analysis, underwriting, and deal structuring
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify risks, trends, and opportunities from data, and translate analysis into actionable strategy
  • Proficiency with data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau) and strong general computer skills
  • Strong interpersonal, negotiation, leadership, and verbal/written communication skills; comfortable engaging with senior management
  • Proactive self-starter with a positive, can-do attitude and sound organizational and time-management skills
Benefits

  • Flextime earned for additional hours worked over 8 hour days
  • 401(K) Matching Plan
  • Company Profit Sharing Plan

Someone who has already had a senior career and now wants a high-trust, high-autonomy right-hand role rather than climbing a traditional corporate ladder. ✅ Confidence to step in and make decisions with the information you have and keep things moving forward

✅ Comfort operating with ambiguity - able to take a messy or incomplete request, figure out what's actually needed, and create a path forward

The ideal person is warm, kind and polite, but with get-things-done energy. Someone who fits the culture of the existing team - people who care about what they do and how they treat each other. The Opportunity

At Praxis, we are looking for a senior contracts attorney and recognized subject matter expert to join our lean, agile Legal team at an important point in the company’s growth. As we advance our pipeline toward commercialization, our contracting needs are growing in both volume and complexity. You will serve as the principal advisor on contracting for the company and will set the strategy, standards, and operating model for the contracting function—getting important work done today while helping us build smarter, more scalable ways of working for what comes next.

You’ll join a team that moves quickly and expects Legal to help the business move with confidence. You’ll bring both a legal and business lens to your work: understanding what teams are trying to accomplish, asking the right questions, focusing on the risks that truly matter, and providing clear, practical guidance. You’ll be trusted to use good judgment, make decisions when the path isn’t perfectly defined, and help teams move forward. You will operate with wide latitude to set your own objectives and priorities, resolve novel questions where precedent and information are limited, and make binding decisions on negotiated positions within delegated authority.

You’ll thrive in this role if you like to build, not just advise. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Praxis approaches contracting by creating practical tools, simplifying processes, challenging unnecessary complexity, and continually looking for better ways to work. Success will mean becoming a recognized internal authority on contracting and a trusted partner across every function—someone who takes ownership, speaks candidly, follows through, and helps us move with both speed and quality while protecting Praxis, our programs, and ultimately the patients we serve. The standards you set and the positions you take will carry well beyond Legal, shaping how Clinical, Technical Operations, Commercial, Finance, and Procurement contract with third parties over a multi-year horizon.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as lead negotiator on the company’s most complex, highest-value, and most strategically significant agreements. Lead the drafting, review, negotiation, and execution of contracts across clinical, development, manufacturing, commercial, and corporate activities, including clinical trial agreements, CRO agreements, investigator and site agreements, vendor contracts, partnership arrangements, strategic collaboration and license agreements, master service agreements, statements of work, commercial manufacturing agreements, and agreements with payors and pharmacies.
  • Define, own, and continuously improve the end-to-end contract lifecycle, including intake, prioritization, negotiation, approvals, execution, organization, and ongoing management, with a focus on increasing speed, consistency, and scalability. Establish the multi-year contracting roadmap, including the standards, thresholds, and target operating model the company will carry through commercial launch and beyond.
  • Apply strong business judgment to contracting decisions by understanding the underlying business objective, distinguishing meaningful risk from theoretical risk, providing clear recommendations, and helping stakeholders make informed tradeoffs and move forward. Resolve significant and unprecedented questions where guidance is limited and outcomes must be weighed against intangible factors such as program timelines, partner relationships, and reputational exposure.
  • Provide practical legal guidance to Clinical Operations and related teams in support of clinical trial start-up and execution, including matters involving clinical sites, investigators, informed consent, data privacy, study vendors, and clinical study agreements.
  • Partner with Compliance and other stakeholders to ensure contract templates, standard terms, playbooks, fallback positions, and negotiated agreements appropriately reflect applicable legal and regulatory requirements; identify material risk early and escalate when appropriate.
  • Serve as a key Legal partner in vendor selection and pre-contract risk assessment, collaborating with Procurement, Finance, Compliance, IT, and business owners to evaluate legal, compliance, privacy, and operational risks associated with third parties.
  • Leverage AI and other legal technology to improve the speed, quality, and consistency of contracting and Legal operations, including identifying opportunities to automate lower-value work, strengthen knowledge management, and enable better decision-making.

Qualifications and Key Success Factors

  • JD from an ABA-accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 5+ years of relevant legal experience gained in-house, at a law firm, or through a combination of both. Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, or another regulated life sciences environment is strongly preferred.
  • Expert-level experience drafting and negotiating a broad range of commercial agreements. Experience with clinical-development contracting is highly valued.
  • Demonstrated ability to assess legal risk in the context of business objectives and provide practical, decisive recommendations rather than defaulting to the most conservative answer.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI tools and a strong interest in using emerging technology responsibly to improve legal work, decision-making, and operational efficiency.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and/or maintaining a contracting function or operating model, including the design of templates, playbooks, policy, and governance adopted across an organization.
  • The physical and mental requirements of our roles include but are not limited to regular use of a computer, devices or other office equipment, clear communication, and occasional movement. You'll need comfort with screen work, basic hand coordination, and focus. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.
Annualized Base Salary
$200,000—$225,000 USD

Compensation & BenefitsAt Praxis, we believe that taking care of our people (and their people) is important, so we provide a world class benefits package to help you thrive.  This includes 99% of the premium paid for medical, dental and vision plans. We also provide company-paid life insurance, AD&D, disability benefits, and voluntary plans to personalize your coverage. Thinking about the future?  We match dollar-for-dollar up to 6% on eligible 401(k) contributions and sweeten the deal with long-term stock incentives and ESPP.  We provide a discretionary quarterly bonus, an extremely flexible wellness benefit, generous PTO, paid holidays and company-wide shutdowns.  Not to mention, you'll also be joining a phenomenal crew of colleagues who are smart, engaged and inspiring.  We aim high, collaborate hard, and produce results.  Let’s achieve the impossible together!

Company Overview

Praxis Precision Medicines is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company translating genetic insights into the development of therapies for central nervous system disorders characterized by neuronal imbalance. At Praxis we share a common vision of reshaping the human condition into a more freeing and fulfilled existence by developing high impact medicines for patients and families affected by and living with complex brain disorders. Our core Values of Trust, Ownership, Curiosity and Results are foundational to every aspect of our business and are exemplified by each and every one of our team members.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion
Guided by our core values, at Praxis Precision Medicines, Inc. we continue to DARE FOR MORE® to advance, promote, and champion diversity, equity, and inclusion by encouraging individuals to bring their authentic selves and perspectives to work each day. We are an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, religious creed, color, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, sexual orientation, disability, genetics, military service and veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of experience working with executive stakeholders.
  • Experience leading territory planning, account segmentation, forecasting, pipeline inspection, and annual sales planning processes.
  • Deep understanding of quota planning, sales capacity modeling, and quota governance, with the ability to align quotas to business strategy and commercial objectives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Strong proficiency with Salesforce, Tableau, SQL, or similar business intelligence and CRM platforms.
  • Experience operating in a high-growth or transformational environment where Sales Operations played a strategic role in scaling the business.

Durable Skills

raw.description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

What It's Like to Work Here

  • Ownership is real, not aspirational. An analyst here can own a data product end-to-end — from methodology to client delivery — and present directly to the investors who depend on it. You won't spend months waiting for "meaningful work."
  • Growth is driven by impact, not tenure. Scope and responsibility expand as fast as you can demonstrate you're ready. We promote based on what you've done, not how long you've been here.
  • AI is a core working tool, not a side project. We're actively rebuilding how analytical work gets done — using AI agents, automation, and new tooling to fundamentally change what's possible. If you're excited about that, you'll thrive here.

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About The Role:

You'll be joining the data feeds part of our organization, focusing on Kepler, a tractions feed that tracks over $45 billion in US consumer transactions across 600+ merchants and 200+ tickers.

Our data feeds help the world's top investors understand company performance, market trends, and competitive dynamics. Kepler serves both fundamental investors, who use our data to inform research and investment theses, and systematic funds, who integrate our feeds directly into quantitative models and trading strategies. This dual audience, along with daily feed delivery on a very short lag, means the bar for accuracy, consistency, and reliability is exceptionally high.

As a Data Analyst for Kepler, you'll ramp quickly and build deep expertise in our third-party and proprietary datasets and methodologies. Working closely with customers, Product, Data Science, and Engineering, you'll take full ownership of the Kepler data — ensuring accuracy, improving methodologies, implementing QA frameworks, and prototyping enhancements that engineering will turn into robust, reliable data pipelines.

This is a role for someone who wants to go deep on hard analytical problems, takes pride in getting the details right, and is motivated by owning work that matters. You'll work cross-functionally with teams across the organization to deliver best-in-class outputs. You'll also be expected to bring ideas, not just execute on others’.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarter is located), one of our office hubs, or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

As a Feeds Data Analyst, you will:

  • Own Kepler data content end-to-end — driving product success by delivering best-in-class outputs with a focus on accuracy, and continuously increasing client value.
  • Work with massive amounts of data and develop deep expertise in our proprietary methods and techniques, building strong mental models that allow you to ensure data accuracy, identify methodology gaps, and derive key insights.
  • Tackle complex data problems using strong analytical judgment to refine methodologies, test new datasets, and solve challenges that require creative thinking — even when information is incomplete or ambiguous.
  • Use AI and tooling to drive meaningful leverage — increasing speed, reducing manual work, and automating portions of workflows. You'll build repeatable processes, maintain a high bar for correctness and quality, and validate AI-generated outputs.
  • Use AI to drive client-value — you will write prompts and run automated evaluation processes to ensure our client-facing Kepler Insight Agent is accurate and able to answer the questions our customers are asking.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Research, Engineering, and other teams — coordinating across functions to unblock work, align on best practices, and develop solutions that streamline workflows and optimize data processes.

Help our customers understand the data by handling high-complexity questions about anomalies and trends in the data that our first line of support can’t handle.

You Are Likely To Succeed If:

  • You have 4-6+ years of experience in data analytics, with a background in fields like financial services, management consulting, data science, or high-growth technology — or another environment where you worked with complex data to drive high-stakes decisions
  • You have expert fluency in SQL and experience using Python or PySpark, including building reliable, reusable analysis workflows
  • You have a proven track record of quickly learning complex data methodologies and building strong mental models of how and why data works
  • You have led complex, ambiguous projects with multiple stakeholders — scoping the approach, driving alignment, and delivering outcomes — with a strong bias toward action and ownership
  • You can clearly communicate complex concepts — including methodology, risks, and tradeoffs — and influence cross-functional partners to move decisions forward
  • You actively use AI tools and are excited about using AI to drive leverage — not just productivity, but fundamentally better and faster ways of working

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, and a competitive salary:

  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!
  • The annual base compensation for this position is anticipated to be $165K-$185K. The final offer may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, as well as internal team benchmarks.
  • The total compensation package includes a mix of base, bonus, equity, and benefits

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. Income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
