raw.title: Field/Event Marketing & Community Relations Manager
raw.excerpt: Company Overview Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Agility PR Solutions is a global leader in media intelligence and PR technology. Founded in 2003, we help communications teams around the world drive awareness, make smarter decisions, and protect their reputation when it matters most. Our enterprise-grade platform unifies media relations, media monitoring, social listening, AI visibility, and media intelligence into a single seamless system—turning overwhelming streams of coverage and conversation into decision-ready intelligence. Recognized for ease of use, results, and customer support, Agility is one of the most trusted names in media intelligence. Our mission is to empower the voices that shape the world's narratives, and we're looking for people who want to help us do it.

About the Role

Reporting to the Associate Director, Demand Generation, this role owns everywhere Agility shows up live: the in-person tradeshow calendar, every webinar we host, our flagship annual virtual event, intimate executive gatherings, and the foundations of our practitioner community. Significant in-person event travel is part of the job — you should want that.

You are analytical by nature, because the tradeshow calendar is yours completely: analyzing past show results to rank what actually worked, selecting next year's shows with our heads of sales, and owning booth operations, sponsorships, and pre- and post-show strategy for every one. You are also genuinely creative — the customer dinner with the right music and entertainment, the booth mechanic that draws real traffic, whether that's candy or a hired barista. Memorable beats expensive.

Every virtual event is yours end to end. You run all of our webinars — including moderating in the background when needed — and our named monthly webinar series. You deliver Signal Day, our flagship annual virtual event, against honest targets (800 registrations, roughly 400 live attendees) with a defined pivot mechanism if registration tracks below the floor. Pre-event and post-event engagement arcs — for webinars and tradeshows alike — are designed with, and executed inside, the Associate Director's funnel architecture.

You put our research on stage. Our Director of Communications & Content owns two flagship research reports; you own the launch webinars and derivative live events that turn each report into a season of programming.

You also run our intimate executive formats — roundtables and dinners for Enterprise & Government audiences — which are our deliberate alternative to the mega-conference model: we win the room of twelve.

On community: you build the foundation. Our practitioner community and ambassador program start from audiences we already own — our webinar and event attendees, our awards entrants, and our strongest customer advocates — with engagement mechanics wired to Signal Day: challenges in the run-up, champion recognition, and VIP access as the reward. The year-one milestone is a named ambassador cohort of 15–25 passionate Agility users with a defined give-and-get, plus a presence in regional PR associations. Our publication's audience belongs to our content organization; you activate that audience live.

What Success Looks Like

  • The tradeshow portfolio is ranked by measured ROI, with data-driven recommendations to sales on next year's calendar.
  • Every show runs with a documented pre- and post-show engagement plan, and post-show analysis lands within two weeks.
  • The webinar program runs on cadence with pre- and post-event arcs, and you can run one solo — including background moderation — without drama.
  • Signal Day hits its registration and attendance targets, or the pivot mechanism executes cleanly and on time.
  • Both flagship research reports get full readout programming: launch webinar plus derivative live events.
  • The ambassador cohort of 15–25 is named, active, and wired to Signal Day mechanics by year end.
  • Every event — field or virtual — feeds pipeline measurably, and you can show which ones feed it best.

What you’ll do

Tradeshows & Field

  • Own the tradeshow calendar end to end: selection with sales leadership, budgets, sponsorships, booth operations, and logistics.
  • Analyze past show performance and rank the portfolio by return; recommend the calendar with data.
  • Design creative on-site experiences: customer dinners, entertainment, and booth-traffic mechanics that people remember.
  • Run pre- and post-show engagement strategy for every event.

Webinars & Flagship Virtual Event

  • Run every webinar Agility hosts end to end, including background moderation when needed.
  • Operate the named monthly webinar series on a reliable cadence.
  • Deliver Signal Day: registration drive, production, live operations, and the pivot decision process.
  • Execute pre- and post-event engagement arcs inside the demand generation funnel architecture.

Research Readouts & Executive Formats

  • Produce the launch webinar and derivative live events for each flagship research report.
  • Design and run executive roundtables and dinners for Enterprise & Government audiences.
  • Coordinate review-solicitation moments with product marketing at events.

Community & Ambassadors

  • Build the foundation of the practitioner community from owned audiences: event attendees, awards entrants, and customer advocates.
  • Stand up the ambassador program: recruit the 15–25 member cohort, define the give-and-get, and run the engagement mechanics wired to Signal Day.
  • Build Agility's presence in regional PR associations, riding the tradeshow calendar.

What You'll Bring

  • B2B event marketing experience spanning both in-person tradeshows and virtual events, ideally in SaaS.
  • An analytical spine: you measure event ROI, rank a portfolio, and recommend with data.
  • Proven virtual event production skill: platforms, run-of-show, moderation, and the calm to run it solo.
  • Creative experience design instincts, with examples of event moments that people remembered.
  • Exceptional organization under concurrency: multiple event timelines at different stages, all on track.
  • A proactive, sense-of-urgency working style — events do not wait, and neither do you.
  • Comfort with significant travel during show season.
  • Community-building or ambassador program experience an asset.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Fully remote work environment
  • Collaborative culture – and key tools enabling it
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Health, Dental & Vision benefits
  • RRSP matching
  • Life Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Career Development & Progression opportunities
  • Paid Vacation, Personal Days and Sick days
  • Flex Fridays in Summer, Week off between Christmas and New Years'
  • No Internal Meetings Fridays

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is C$80,000–C$110,000 annually, plus a target bonus of 12–15%. Final compensation will reflect the successful candidate's experience, skills, and internal equity.

This is a new position.

AI Usage

We use technology to make hiring smarter, faster, and more personal, never less human. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools help us manage applications efficiently and highlight qualifications that align with each role, allowing our recruiters to focus more on meaningful conversations with candidates. AI does not make hiring decisions at Agility. Every decision is made by people, our hiring managers and recruitment professionals, who are trained to apply sound judgment and equitable practices at every stage. We believe technology exists to amplify human insight, not replace it. That belief shapes how we build relationships, tell stories, and grow our teams.

At Agility, we strive every day to build a more inclusive work environment and introduce tools that enable it. We strongly encourage applications from all people regardless of race, religion, gender, age, disability status or sexual orientation.

Even if you find yourself not checking all the boxes of our listed requirements but you are excited about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you anyway. Our Talent Acquisition team will review your application for this role, and other potential role matches open now or in the future.

If, at any stage of the application process, you require accommodation owing to disability or a medical need, please let us know at for us to make appropriate arrangements.

raw.excerpt: ABOUT CHANGING LIVES PRODUCTIONS:Changing Lives Productions is the in-house video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, the #1 creator of scripted positive content online.
raw.description:
ABOUT CHANGING LIVES PRODUCTIONS:

Changing Lives Productions is the in-house video production company of Dhar Mann Studios, the #1 creator of scripted positive content online. With over 163 million followers and 45+ billion views across YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok, our videos receive more than 1 billion views each month.

We produce several hours of original content weekly with messages of compassion, kindness, and altruism that resonate with viewers of all ages. Our stories tackle real-life challenges and deliver powerful life lessons that resonate with global audiences.

Founded by Dhar Mann, named the "Moral Philosopher of YouTube" by The New York Times, a Time Top 100 Creator, and ranked #2 on Forbes' 2025 Top Creators list - our founding principle is simple but ambitious: We're not just telling stories. We're changing lives.

BIG PICTURE:

Why This Role Matters: Too much important work still depends on someone remembering to do it. We are seeking an exceptionally resourceful, systems-oriented AI & Automation Operations Manager to design, improve, and manage the processes that support a fast-moving entrepreneur, family office, and administrative team. The objective is straightforward: build systems that make important work difficult to forget, difficult to drop, and easy to execute correctly.

This is not a traditional Administrative Assistant position. We already have team members who can execute tasks. This role steps back, evaluates how work is being done, and asks: Why does someone have to remember to do this? Why isn't there a reliable system for this? Can AI, automation, or better process design make this faster and more dependable? How do we make sure this process is still working six months from now?

The role combines AI implementation, automation, process design, systems management, and high-level administrative operations. It works in close partnership with the Admin Manager and administrative team as a systems and operational partner, strengthening the processes, tools, and infrastructure behind the administrative function rather than duplicating the Admin Manager's role.

HOW YOU'LL SPEND YOUR TIME:

  • Identify repetitive or inefficient administrative work and determine where AI, automation, and better process design can improve speed, reliability, accuracy, and scalability.
  • Build automated workflows across administrative systems and tools so information moves automatically instead of relying on manual updates.
  • Create reminders, triggers, alerts, and escalation systems for overdue or time-sensitive tasks, and automate recurring reports, updates, and status communications.
  • Use AI to research, summarize, organize, draft, and analyze, and develop effective prompts, templates, and reusable AI workflows for the team.
  • Audit how recurring administrative responsibilities are currently handled and find where tasks, information, or follow-ups fall through the cracks.
  • Build and maintain SOPs, checklists, workflows, and operating procedures with clear ownership, deadlines, reminders, escalation paths, and quality control, so important work is verified rather than assumed.
  • Keep recurring processes (inventories, subscription and account reviews, invoice follow-ups, weekly, monthly, and quarterly administrative reviews) running reliably months after they are built, without depending on one person remembering every step.
  • Close loops on open tasks: track follow-ups, escalate when needed, and improve the process so the same bottleneck does not happen twice.
  • Partner with the Admin Manager on priorities, pain points, and process-improvement projects from problem identification through implementation, documentation, and follow-through.
  • Research and prepare concise summaries and recommendations to support administrative decision-making, and organize the trackers, databases, and documentation the team relies on.
  • Evaluate emerging AI tools, train team members on the ones that are genuinely useful, and continuously find administrative work that can be simplified, automated, or eliminated.
  • Step in to support administrative work when necessary, always asking: should this require the same amount of manual effort next time?

WHAT YOU HAVE:

  • You naturally think in systems and processes. You do not just see tasks; you see the system behind them, and you want to simplify, streamline, or automate it.
  • Hands-on experience building real workflows with AI platforms (ChatGPT or similar), AI agents, and automation platforms such as Zapier, Make, or n8n.
  • Working knowledge of Slack, Google Workspace, Airtable, Notion, project-management platforms (Asana, monday.com, ClickUp, or similar), forms, databases, dashboards, and reporting tools. APIs, webhooks, and spreadsheet automation are a plus.
  • Experience turning informal or inconsistent ways of working into SOPs and documented processes that teams actually follow.
  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong organization, and consistent follow-through. You document processes naturally and think through edge cases and failure points.
  • You work independently without constant direction, take initiative instead of waiting for permission, and are comfortable holding people accountable to agreed-upon processes.
  • You communicate clearly and concisely, balance speed with accuracy, and are resourceful when the answer is not immediately obvious.
  • Awareness of AI cost management, security, privacy, and access controls.
  • You do not need to be a software engineer, but when someone describes a repetitive administrative problem, your instinct is to start thinking about how to systemize it.

WHO OVERSEES YOU:

The AI & Automation Operations Manager reports to the Automation Lead. This role works in close partnership with the Admin Manager and administrative team as a systems and operational partner.

WHERE IT ALL GOES DOWN:

This role is fully remote, working from home or a personal office, supporting a distributed administrative team across time zones.

WHEN THE MAGIC HAPPENS:

The typical work schedule is 40 hours a week, Monday - Friday. Specific hours and timezone overlap will be discussed during the interview.

Salary: $12 to $15 /hr

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

L'équipe Account Manager s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras :

En tant qu’Account Manager Full Cycle, tu occupes un rôle stratégique au sein de l’équipe commerciale et prends la responsabilité d’un portefeuille de clients existants.

Ta mission : développer durablement la valeur de ton portefeuille, en pilotant l’ensemble du cycle de vie client, de l’onboarding au renouvellement, en passant par l’adoption et l’expansion.

Ton rôle s’articule autour de trois priorités :

  • Sécuriser : anticiper les renouvellements, protéger le revenu récurrent et limiter le churn.

  • Développer : identifier et convertir les opportunités d’upsell et d’expansion pour faire croître l’ARR de ton portefeuille.

  • Accompagner : assurer l’onboarding, favoriser l’adoption et construire une relation client créatrice de valeur dans la durée.

Missions

Fidéliser & sécuriser ton portefeuille

  • Piloter ton portefeuille dans une logique de rétention et de développement du revenu récurrent.

  • Identifier les risques de désengagement et mettre en place les actions nécessaires pour prévenir le churn.

  • Anticiper les échéances contractuelles et piloter les renouvellements suffisamment en amont.

  • Mener les négociations de renouvellement en sécurisant le revenu et en favorisant, lorsque cela est pertinent, des engagements à plus long terme.

  • Suivre la santé de tes comptes grâce aux données d’usage, aux niveaux d’engagement et aux différents signaux clients.

Développer l’ARR de ton portefeuille

  • Identifier et convertir les opportunités d’upsell et d’expansion : nouveaux utilisateurs, extension de périmètre, fonctionnalités, formations ou services complémentaires.

  • Construire des stratégies de développement adaptées au potentiel et aux enjeux de chaque compte.

  • Transformer les signaux d’usage et d’adoption en opportunités commerciales concrètes.

  • Piloter tes opportunités d’expansion de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la négociation et au closing.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes BDR et Marketing pour maximiser le potentiel de développement de ton portefeuille.

  • Prendre en charge et développer les nouveaux comptes qui te sont attribués.

Onboarder & accélérer l’adoption

  • Piloter l’onboarding des nouveaux clients autour de leurs cas d’usage, objectifs et KPIs de succès.

  • Définir les premiers jalons permettant aux clients de percevoir rapidement la valeur d’AssessFirst.

  • Favoriser l’activation et la récurrence d’usage dès les 30 à 60 premiers jours.

  • Assurer une transition fluide entre l’onboarding et la gestion long terme du compte.

Créer et démontrer de la valeur

  • Comprendre les enjeux business et RH de tes clients pour faire évoluer leur utilisation d’AssessFirst.

  • Les accompagner dans la traduction de leurs usages en résultats business mesurables.

  • Animer des Success Reviews régulières pour valoriser les résultats obtenus et identifier les prochaines opportunités.

  • Renforcer la perception de valeur tout au long de la relation, notamment en préparation des renouvellements et des discussions d’expansion.

  • Adopter une véritable posture de conseil, capable de challenger et d’accompagner les clients dans leurs enjeux.

Piloter ton activité & ton portefeuille

  • Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des clients de ton portefeuille et garantir un suivi régulier, structuré et proactif.

  • Maintenir un reporting fiable sur les renouvellements, opportunités d’expansion, risques et forecasts.

  • Piloter tes indicateurs de performance et ajuster tes plans d’action lorsque nécessaire.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour garantir une expérience client fluide et cohérente.

  • Être force de proposition pour améliorer nos process commerciaux, notre offre et l’expérience client.

Ta future équipe

Tu feras partie de la team Account Manager, composée de 5 personnes et managée parDuncan.

Expérience souhaitée

🚀 Minimum 4 ans d’expérience en Account Management / Key Account / Account Executive en SaaS B2B

🧑‍💻 Expérience sur des comptes stratégiques ou grands comptes

📈 Forte culture business (NRR, expansion, croissance)

🧠 Mentalité de développeur et approche proactive

🤝 Excellentes compétences en négociation et closing

🧭 Capacité à naviguer dans des organisations complexes

⚙️ Maîtrise des CRM (Hubspot, Salesforce…)

🇬🇧 Anglais professionnel courant indispensable

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale :Package 96K à objectifs atteints (répartition : 40% fixe - 60% variable)

Autonomie & flexibilité :tu t’organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote :travaille d’où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍

Tickets resto :carte Swile à 10 € par jour travaillé.

Mutuelle :couverture santé avec Alan.

Épargne & participation :dispositif d’épargne salariale et de participation.

Bien-être :participation à tes activités sportives, chèques cadeaux et plateforme d’avantages.

Coworking :accès à des espaces partagés jusqu’à 6 fois par mois avec Worklib.

Vie d’équipe :une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

Notre processus de recrutement:

  1. Notre annonce te parle et te donne envie d’en savoir plus

  2. Tu remplis nos tests en ligne en postulant (tu recevras un lien par email).

  3. L'équipe Talent te contacte

  4. 3 entretiens maximum : un rôle play avec Duncan (ton futur n+1) et Romain (Head of Sales), un échange avec Quentin (CEO), et enfin David notre fondateur !

  5. Bienvenue, tu fais désormais partie de l'équipe ! 👏

raw.title: Senior Regulatory Analyst and Writer
raw.excerpt: Location: Remote, United States.  Core availability 9:00 a.
raw.description:
Location: Remote, United States. Core availability 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Eastern, Monday through Friday.

Type: Full time, salaried.

Eligibility: U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident.

The role

This is the analytical center of the contract and the face of it to the client. When a comment period closes on a proposed Packers and Stockyards Act rule, you are the person who reads what the public sent in, works out what actually matters in it, and turns thousands of pages into something the agency's policy staff can use to write a final rule.

Between rulemakings you run the contract: the deliverable tracking, the monthly reporting, the weekly client meetings, and the readiness work that makes the next sprint survivable. You will also direct the analyst bench during comment closes, setting the coding scheme and reviewing what comes back.

The turnaround is fifteen calendar days from the close of the comment period for both the substantive analysis and the key issues matrix, and the client has signaled they may want it faster. This job suits someone who does careful work quickly and does not need to be managed through a deadline.

Analysis and writing

  • Analyze public comments submitted on proposed rules, identifying themes, high-risk issues, quantitative metrics such as comment counts by topic, recommendations from the public, and the line between substantive and non-substantive submissions.
  • Distinguish organized form-letter campaigns from unique substantive comments and account for both in the analysis.
  • Identify every issue raised through public comment and build the key issues matrix, with comments sorted and categorized by issue for policy discussion and for drafting written responses in the final rule.
  • Write summaries that hold up under legal and policy review and that support the agency's response obligations under the Administrative Procedure Act.
  • Deliver written material that meets federal, and preferably USDA, style guidance and Section 508 accessibility requirements.
  • Set the coding scheme for each rulemaking and review the analyst bench's output against it.

Running the contract

  • Maintain a one-page deliverable tracking sheet, updated weekly and submitted electronically to the client throughout the contract.
  • Lead the kick-off meeting within ten business days of award and develop the project plan that follows from it.
  • Write and submit monthly progress reports to the Contracting Officer's Representative covering technical progress, schedule status, and any concerns or recommendations.
  • Run weekly virtual status meetings with the client on comment volume, processing progress, schedule risk, and emerging themes, and document decisions in internal meeting notes.
  • Forecast comment volume as it accumulates and tell Connexus early how much bench support each close will need.
  • Escalate anything that looks like scope creep to Connexus management rather than absorbing it.

What you need

  • Bachelor's degree. Advanced degree in public policy, law, economics, agricultural economics, or a related field is welcome.
  • Thorough working understanding of the federal notice-and-comment rulemaking process and the Administrative Procedure Act.
  • Direct experience analyzing or responding to public comments on a federal rulemaking, whether at an agency, a contractor, a law firm, or a trade association.
  • Demonstrable knowledge of federal regulatory and stylistic requirements for public comment processing and rulemaking.
  • Strong analytical writing. You will be asked for a writing sample.
  • Familiarity with the Federal Document Management System and regulations.gov.
  • Experience producing Section 508 compliant documents.
  • Comfortable owning a client relationship, including writing status reports a federal reviewer will read closely.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams, Zoom, and Adobe Acrobat Pro.

Nice to have

  • USDA experience, particularly with AMS, or familiarity with the Packers and Stockyards Act and livestock and poultry markets.
  • Experience with high-volume comment dockets and mass-comment campaigns.
  • Prior work directing junior analysts on deadline.
  • Working knowledge of qualitative coding or text analysis tooling.
Salary: $95K+ DOE

raw.description:
L'équipe Account Manager s'agrandit !

AssessFirst, en quelques mots 👇

Nous sommes une HR Tech en forte croissance, avec une mission claire : révolutionner le recrutement à l’échelle mondiale.
Plutôt que de se baser sur le CV, nous aidons les entreprises à prédire la performance et l’épanouissement des talents grâce à l’analyse de leur personnalité, de leurs motivations et de leur capacité à apprendre.
Aujourd’hui, nous sommes plus de 110 collaborateurs et accompagnons 3 500+ clients dans plus de 40 pays, pour recruter et faire évoluer leurs équipes de manière plus inclusive et plus efficace.
Notre culture ? Ambition, impact et liberté.
Tu veux contribuer à transformer le futur du travail ? On veut te rencontrer.

Ce que tu feras :

En tant qu’Account Manager Full Cycle, tu occupes un rôle stratégique au sein de l’équipe commerciale et prends la responsabilité d’un portefeuille de clients existants.

Ta mission : développer durablement la valeur de ton portefeuille, en pilotant l’ensemble du cycle de vie client, de l’onboarding au renouvellement, en passant par l’adoption et l’expansion.

Ton rôle s’articule autour de trois priorités :

  • Sécuriser : anticiper les renouvellements, protéger le revenu récurrent et limiter le churn.

  • Développer : identifier et convertir les opportunités d’upsell et d’expansion pour faire croître l’ARR de ton portefeuille.

  • Accompagner : assurer l’onboarding, favoriser l’adoption et construire une relation client créatrice de valeur dans la durée.

Missions

Fidéliser & sécuriser ton portefeuille

  • Piloter ton portefeuille dans une logique de rétention et de développement du revenu récurrent.

  • Identifier les risques de désengagement et mettre en place les actions nécessaires pour prévenir le churn.

  • Anticiper les échéances contractuelles et piloter les renouvellements suffisamment en amont.

  • Mener les négociations de renouvellement en sécurisant le revenu et en favorisant, lorsque cela est pertinent, des engagements à plus long terme.

  • Suivre la santé de tes comptes grâce aux données d’usage, aux niveaux d’engagement et aux différents signaux clients.

Développer l’ARR de ton portefeuille

  • Identifier et convertir les opportunités d’upsell et d’expansion : nouveaux utilisateurs, extension de périmètre, fonctionnalités, formations ou services complémentaires.

  • Construire des stratégies de développement adaptées au potentiel et aux enjeux de chaque compte.

  • Transformer les signaux d’usage et d’adoption en opportunités commerciales concrètes.

  • Piloter tes opportunités d’expansion de l’identification du besoin jusqu’à la négociation et au closing.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes BDR et Marketing pour maximiser le potentiel de développement de ton portefeuille.

  • Prendre en charge et développer les nouveaux comptes qui te sont attribués.

Onboarder & accélérer l’adoption

  • Piloter l’onboarding des nouveaux clients autour de leurs cas d’usage, objectifs et KPIs de succès.

  • Définir les premiers jalons permettant aux clients de percevoir rapidement la valeur d’AssessFirst.

  • Favoriser l’activation et la récurrence d’usage dès les 30 à 60 premiers jours.

  • Assurer une transition fluide entre l’onboarding et la gestion long terme du compte.

Créer et démontrer de la valeur

  • Comprendre les enjeux business et RH de tes clients pour faire évoluer leur utilisation d’AssessFirst.

  • Les accompagner dans la traduction de leurs usages en résultats business mesurables.

  • Animer des Success Reviews régulières pour valoriser les résultats obtenus et identifier les prochaines opportunités.

  • Renforcer la perception de valeur tout au long de la relation, notamment en préparation des renouvellements et des discussions d’expansion.

  • Adopter une véritable posture de conseil, capable de challenger et d’accompagner les clients dans leurs enjeux.

Piloter ton activité & ton portefeuille

  • Être l’interlocuteur privilégié des clients de ton portefeuille et garantir un suivi régulier, structuré et proactif.

  • Maintenir un reporting fiable sur les renouvellements, opportunités d’expansion, risques et forecasts.

  • Piloter tes indicateurs de performance et ajuster tes plans d’action lorsque nécessaire.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes internes pour garantir une expérience client fluide et cohérente.

  • Être force de proposition pour améliorer nos process commerciaux, notre offre et l’expérience client.

Ta future équipe

Tu feras partie de la team Account Manager, composée de 5 personnes et managée parDuncan.

Expérience souhaitée

🚀 Minimum 4 ans d’expérience en Account Management / Key Account / Account Executive en SaaS B2B

🧑‍💻 Expérience sur des comptes stratégiques ou grands comptes

📈 Forte culture business (NRR, expansion, croissance)

🧠 Mentalité de développeur et approche proactive

🤝 Excellentes compétences en négociation et closing

🧭 Capacité à naviguer dans des organisations complexes

⚙️ Maîtrise des CRM (Hubspot, Salesforce…)

🇬🇧 Anglais professionnel courant indispensable

Qu'est ce que tu obtiendras ?

Fourchette salariale :Package 96K à objectifs atteints (répartition : 40% fixe - 60% variable)

Autonomie & flexibilité :tu t’organises librement selon les priorités et les projets du moment.

Full remote :travaille d’où tu veux en Europe ! 🌍

Tickets resto :carte Swile à 10 € par jour travaillé.

Mutuelle :couverture santé avec Alan.

Épargne & participation :dispositif d’épargne salariale et de participation.

Bien-être :participation à tes activités sportives, chèques cadeaux et plateforme d’avantages.

Coworking :accès à des espaces partagés jusqu’à 6 fois par mois avec Worklib.

Vie d’équipe :une culture forte et quatre séminaires par an pour se retrouver.

Notre processus de recrutement:

  1. Notre annonce te parle et te donne envie d’en savoir plus

  2. Tu remplis nos tests en ligne en postulant (tu recevras un lien par email).

  3. L'équipe Talent te contacte

  4. 3 entretiens maximum : un rôle play avec Duncan (ton futur n+1) et Romain (Head of Sales), un échange avec Quentin (CEO), et enfin David notre fondateur !

  5. Bienvenue, tu fais désormais partie de l'équipe ! 👏

Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

The Senior Autonomy Core Frameworks Software Engineer plays a critical role in architecting and advancing the foundational frameworks that underpin Torc's autonomous driving stack. This role helps in owning technical direction for the software in core autonomy components, helping to raise the bar on code quality, and driving improvements across the autonomy software.

As a senior technical leader, you will collaborate closely with the Behavior and Perception teams within Autonomy to design robust, composable architectural patterns that serve as the foundation for safe, performant, reliable autonomous operation. This position demands deep technical expertise in software architecture and autonomous vehicle fundamentals.

What You’ll Do

  • Champion architectural quality through systematic validation, comprehensive testing strategies, observability frameworks, and production readiness practices that ensure platform robustness at scale.
  • Contribute to root cause analysis of complex platform-level issues and drive architectural improvements that enhance system reliability, performance, and operational resilience.
  • Define and evolve simulation and validation frameworks that enable rigorous testing of core architectural components across diverse operational scenarios and edge cases.
  • Evaluate emerging architectural patterns, systems research, and advanced techniques that can strengthen the platform's foundation and enable future autonomous driving capabilities.
  • Communicate complex architectural concepts and technical vision effectively across engineering teams, product, and leadership while building consensus around platform direction and technical strategy.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or related technical discipline with 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, or
  • Master's degree with 6+ years of professional experience, or
  • Demonstrated success designing and evolving complex, production software platforms with ownership of architectural decisions
  • Deep experienced with C++17 and recent standards
  • Comfortable with using Python to help script and glue systems together
  • Experience working across autonomous systems/robotics, distributed systems, or complex embedded environments using middleware with pub-sub communications patterns
  • Strong experience with testing, continuous integration, and build systems
  • Deep experience with systems-level software design, including experience managing technical debt, refactoring large codebases, and evolving platforms while maintaining stability and performance.
  • Experience mentoring engineers through technical leadership, architecture reviews, code reviews, and establishing engineering standards that scale across organizations.
  • Strong mastery of software engineering fundamentals including modular/composable architecture, design patterns, concurrency, testing strategies, and long-term maintainability.

Bonus Points

  • Experience architecting, maintaining, and using robotics middleware's (E.g., ROS 2)
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems design, including consensus algorithms, state synchronization,event-driven architectures, deterministic replay, etc.
  • Familiarity with ISO 26262, SOTIF, ASPICE, or other safety-critical software development standards.
  • Experience with GitHub Actions and Jenkins
  • Experience with Bazel and Bazel-based build systems
  • Experience designing or building observability, logging, and monitoring systems for complex distributed systems.
  • Experience working with simulations for regression testing
  • Experience managing versioning and conversion of data schemas at scale

raw.description:
About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.
Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.
We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:
Interested in creative tech career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design
Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables
Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules
Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

Build digital products and services 0-1
Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice
Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management
Identify target market for product and position product for launch success
Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales
Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights
Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution
Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables
Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea
Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution
Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options
Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

The application takes a few minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your resume. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.
You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status. If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

raw.description:
Penrod is seeking an Associate Salesforce Data 360/ Marketing Cloud Specialist to join our growing Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud practice. This functional-technical role is designed for an early-career professional or a Salesforce Admin, Marketing Cloud consultant looking to evolve into Data 360. You will execute hands-on configuration and delivery tasks that a Data Cloud or Marketing Cloud Lead has architected and scoped: building data streams, data mapping, identity resolution rulesets, configuring calculated insights, activating segments, and building journeys and automations according to documented designs. This is a foundational delivery role: you work under the direction and mentorship of a Lead Consultant or Architect, building deep platform skills while contributing real, billable work on client engagements.
This role is a launchpad into Penrod's growing Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud practice within Health & Life Sciences. You will work directly alongside experienced Leads and Architects, build in-demand platform skills on real client engagements, and grow along a defined path toward Consultant and Lead-level ownership. We offer a competitive compensation package, comprehensive benefits, and structured mentorship.

What you will do

  • Execute configuration tasks defined by a Data Cloud or Marketing Cloud Lead, including data streams, mapping from DLOs to DMOs, calculated insights, segments, and activation targets, following documented designs and specifications.

  • Build and test ingestion pipeline components, identity resolution rules, data spaces, and activation workflows under the guidance of the Lead Consultant or Architect.

  • Configure Marketing Cloud journeys, automations, and data extensions based on requirements and build plans provided by the Lead.

  • Support data quality validation and reconciliation testing across ingestion and query layers, flagging discrepancies and escalating issues to the Lead.

  • Execute test scripts during QA and UAT cycles, log defects, and track resolution through to sign-off.

  • Document configuration steps, build notes, and known issues to support Penrod's library of reusable implementation patterns and accelerators.

  • Participate in client discovery and working sessions, capturing requirements, documenting business processes, identifying data and platform needs, tracking decisions and action items, and supporting follow-up activities under Lead supervision.

  • Translate business and technical requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, configuration requirements, process flows, and supporting implementation documentation.

  • Develop an understanding of client business objectives and translate use cases into data requirements, audience criteria, segmentation logic, activation requirements, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Learn and apply Penrod's Data Cloud and Marketing Cloud implementation methodology, internal tooling, and accelerators.

  • Support pre-sales scoping by providing basic effort estimates for defined configuration tasks, as directed by the Lead.

  • Ensure all configuration work adheres to HIPAA data handling requirements relevant to HLS clients.

What we look for

  • 1-3 years hands on experience with Salesforce CRM, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Salesforce Data 360, CRM platforms, marketing technology, data/analytics platforms, or related technologies.

  • Working knowledge of core Data Cloud concepts (data streams, DMOs, unified profiles, calculated insights) or Marketing Cloud concepts (journeys, automations, data extensions), gained through training, certification study, or hands-on projects.

  • Basic proficiency in SQL or SOQL for querying, validating, and troubleshooting data.

  • Working understanding of relational data concepts, including tables/objects, fields, data types, primary and foreign keys, relationships, data mapping, and basic data transformation.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to follow documented processes and build specifications accurately.

  • Comfortable working under supervision, incorporating feedback quickly, and asking clarifying questions before executing ambiguous tasks.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills for status updates, documentation, and note-taking in client sessions.

  • Hold a current Salesforce Certified Associate, CDP Accredited Professional, Data Cloud Consultant certification, Marketing Cloud certification (email specialist, Administrator, or Developer). Candidates without relevant Data 360 or Marketing Cloud certifications will be expected to pursue applicable Salesforce certifications as part of their professional development within the first 6 months of employment.

  • Hands-on exposure to Marketing Cloud Engagement capabilities such as Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Email Studio, Contact Builder, Data Extensions, audience segmentation, or SQL Query Activities.

  • Understanding of subscriber/contact management, consent, preferences, suppression, and marketing data governance concepts.

  • Exposure to APIs, SFTP, ETL/ELT processes, CSV/JSON data structures, or other common data integration methods.

  • Coursework, internship, or project experience in Health & Life Sciences.

  • Conceptual familiarity with HIPAA, HL7, or FHIR data standards.

  • Comfort with Excel or Google Sheets for QA tracking and test case management.

  • Exposure to a Salesforce consulting environment or systems integrator setting.

  • Demonstrated interest in growing toward a Data Cloud or Marketing Cloud Consultant or Lead role.

Penrod is a healthcare and life sciences consulting company that empowers exceptional experiences by engaging and consulting on technology and enabling digital transformation. Founded in 2011, a Summit Salesforce Partner since 2016, and HIPAA compliance accredited, Penrod has helped hundreds of companies ranging from startup to the Fortune 500; from pre-FDA approval to full commercialization; from specialty clinic to major healthcare system; improve their own patient experiences and implement technology to meet the challenges of the industry as they continue to evolve.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist

Remote | Personal Injury | Part-Time, 30 hours/week initially | $6.5/hour

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized, dependable, and personable Bilingual Patient Follow-Up Specialist to support a growing personal injury medical practice.

The immediate priority for this role is addressing a significant backlog of patient follow-up calls. You will conduct outbound outreach, document patient recovery progress, support attorney and legal documentation requests, and help ensure that tasks are completed accurately and on time.

The ideal candidate combines strong medical assistant experience with excellent communication, persistence, accuracy, and the ability to handle sensitive patient and legal information with a very high level of attention to detail.

Key Responsibilities

Patient Follow-Up & Outreach

  • Contact patients approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit to check on their recovery and current condition.

  • Conduct consistent outbound outreach through calls, texts, or other approved channels while remaining professional and respectful.

  • Follow up persistently when patients are difficult to reach without becoming overly aggressive or pushy.

Symptom Tracking & Documentation

  • Complete structured follow-up questionnaires regarding symptoms such as headaches, dizziness, and other reported concerns.

  • Record patient responses accurately in the practice's dedicated symptom tracking database.

  • Maintain complete and organized documentation so the physician can easily review patient recovery progress.

Legal Records & Billing Requests

  • Respond to requests from attorneys and law firms for patient evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation.

  • Compile the correct records and ensure all requested information is complete before sending or uploading it.

  • Handle legal and medical documentation with extremely high accuracy because errors can directly affect personal injury cases.

Portal & Task Management

  • Upload completed evaluations, records, bills, and other requested documentation into designated attorney or client portals.

  • Track outstanding requests and completed tasks so documentation does not fall through the cracks.

  • Maintain organized records across the clinic's internal systems and external portals.

Reporting & Operational Reliability

  • Provide End-of-Day reports summarizing completed calls, outreach attempts, pending follow-ups, and finished tasks.

  • Maintain consistent follow-through on assigned responsibilities and communicate quickly when an issue could affect completion.

  • Prioritize accuracy and reliability, particularly when handling patient records, legal requests, and time-sensitive documentation.

Cross-Training & Practice Support

  • Learn the Scheduling & Intake Specialist's core workflows, including scheduling, patient intake, and patient communication.

  • Provide backup coverage when the other VMA is unavailable or when patient volume increases.

  • Assist with incoming calls, emails, patient questions, or administrative work when additional practice support is required.

Required Qualifications

  • Fully fluent in English and Spanish.

  • Previous experience as a Medical Assistant, Medical Receptionist, Virtual Medical Assistant, or similar healthcare support professional.

  • Strong understanding of medical terminology and patient communication.

  • Exceptional attention to detail when entering records or managing documentation.

  • Strong telephone communication skills with a warm, conversational, and patient-centered approach.

  • Comfortable performing frequent outbound patient calls and follow-ups.

  • Highly organized and capable of independently tracking multiple open tasks.

  • Able to work consistently during Mountain Time business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience working with personal injury practices.

  • Experience communicating with attorneys or law firms.

  • Experience fulfilling medical records or billing documentation requests.

  • Familiarity with legal, clinic, or attorney portals.

Tools & Systems

  • Internal Clinic Symptom Database for documenting standardized patient follow-up responses and recovery symptoms.

  • External Law Firm/Clinic Portals for uploading completed evaluations, medical records, bills, and other requested documentation.

  • GoLean Productivity Tool and GoLean Private Network for productivity monitoring and secure access to practice systems and patient information.

What Success Looks Like

  • The existing patient follow-up backlog is steadily cleared, with patients contacted approximately 4 to 6 weeks after their visit and their recovery information documented accurately.

  • Attorney and law firm requests for evaluations, medical records, and billing documentation are completed accurately and on time, with the practice expecting effectively zero preventable errors.

  • Follow-ups, portal uploads, records requests, and outstanding tasks are consistently tracked through completion, with clear End-of-Day reporting and reliable backup coverage for scheduling and intake when needed.

Chooose builds software to enable the lower carbon fuel value chain.

Companies like Delta Air Lines, Cathay Pacific, British Airways, and Microsoft use the Chooose platform to build, operate, and scale their lower carbon fuel programs (typically referred to as Sustainable Aviation Fuel, or SAF), and to advance voluntary and compliance carbon management initiatives.

With offices in Miami and Oslo, and remote employees across the US and Europe, Chooose is relentlessly focused on delivering enterprise software products to enable our customers to drive lower carbon fuel adoption. The company has raised $50M from leading venture capital and strategic investors.

This opportunity is exclusively available as a B2B arrangement

As a Product Owner at Chooose, you will own the end-to-end product vision, roadmap, and execution for your domain. You’ll work with a core team of engineers and designers to build products that enable the largest aviation fuel suppliers and fuel buyers to accelerate their lower carbon fuel business processes.

We’re looking for someone who is energized by ambiguity, deeply curious about the frontier of AI in enterprise products, and passionate about building products that balance technical depth with intuitive user experiences. You’ll need to be hands-on with prototyping and comfortable translating complex systems into clear, user-centered solutions.

This role reports to the CTO.

What you'll do

  • Own the vision, roadmap and execution for a Chooose domain, balancing intuition with data

  • Deeply understand the aviation fuel market and our customers’ needs by spending time with customers

  • Drive high-velocity execution with a distributed team of engineers and designers

  • Prototype rapidly using tools like Cursor to accelerate the product development lifecycle and fast-forward to production-ready products

  • Stay deeply plugged into AI tooling, industry trends, and emergent applications, filtering signal from noise and applying it accelerate execution for the Product team

  • Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization such as Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Account Management, and Operations

What you bring to the table

  • BA/BS in a technical or analytical field (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Applied Sciences, or related)

  • Minimum 4 years of product management or adjacent product-building experience in an enterprise context

  • Strong customer empathy and design thinking

  • Passion for AI, shown through hands-on building, prototyping, or side projects, and staying current on tools

  • Fluency with core LLM concepts and systems, such as prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation, and the judgment to translate these into reliable, user-facing products

  • Fluency with modern prototyping tools (e.g. Cursor, Claude Code) and comfort with design/collaboration environments (Figma)

  • Fluency in data and experimentation, and understanding when the answer cannot be found in the data

  • Proven ability to lead small, technical teams toward ambitious product goals with urgency

  • Ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences, synthesizing complex systems into compelling narratives

  • Native-level English writing and speaking skills

Nice to have

  • Experience building in financial, enterprise, or other compliance-heavy domains requiring precision and complex systems thinking

  • Experience in high growth startups

  • Experience getting results on a distributed team

  • Polish language skills

Not for you if

  • You prefer product strategy briefings over hands-on delivery

  • You’re not building with AI

The interview process

At Chooose, we prioritize transparency throughout our interview process. If your qualifications look like a fit, we’ll begin with a few introductory conversations where you'll have the chance to discuss your experience and learn more about our company. The second phase varies depending on the role and will most likely involve a practical exercise to show your work. The third and final phase consists of a few one-on-one conversation members of the executive team. The process should take approx. 4-6 weeks. While we strive to keep to this timeline, the occasional adjustment may occur; we’re focused on ensuring for enough time to get to know one another.

We value diversity and believe forming teams in which everyone can be their authentic self is key to our success. We encourage people from underrepresented backgrounds and different industries to apply.

Compensation will be based on experience and skill, commensurate with market rates, and will include both a monthly fee and equity in Chooose.

Chooose is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion (creed), gender, gender expression, age, national origin (ancestry), disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or military status. We are committed to providing an inclusive and welcoming environment to our employees and welcome input from candidates and employees on how we can enhance our inclusiveness.

Prerequisite for Employment: Chooose may request to conduct background checks on prospective applicants to verify the information provided in the CV, transcripts, and other documentation. This background check may be carried out by our partner and will not be conducted without the applicant's prior consent. Prospective applicants will receive more information about this.

Investment Banking Associate – M&A, Financial Modeling & Valuation

Full-Time | Remote | U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an Investment Banking Associate to support live M&A, capital raising, and strategic advisory transactions.

This is a hands-on deal execution role for someone with strong experience in financial modeling, valuation, due diligence, and transaction materials. You’ll work closely with analysts, senior bankers, clients, lawyers, accountants, and advisors to ensure transactions move forward accurately and on schedule.

If you thrive in fast-paced deal environments and can balance rigorous financial analysis with strong execution, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Financial Modeling & Valuation

  • Build and maintain detailed DCF, LBO, and merger models
  • Conduct comparable company and precedent transaction analyses
  • Perform sensitivity and scenario analysis
  • Evaluate financial assumptions and transaction structures
  • Update models using client financials and evolving deal assumptions

M&A & Transaction Execution

  • Support buy-side, sell-side, capital raising, and strategic advisory engagements
  • Manage due diligence checklists and transaction timelines
  • Coordinate virtual data rooms and information requests
  • Work with clients, accountants, lawyers, consultants, and other advisors
  • Ensure transaction deliverables remain accurate and on schedule

Pitch Books & Client Materials

  • Draft and refine:
    • Confidential Information Memoranda (CIMs)
    • Pitch books
    • Teasers
    • Management presentations
    • Investor decks
  • Translate complex financial analysis into polished, client-ready materials
  • Maintain exceptional accuracy and attention to detail

Research & Analysis

  • Conduct industry, company, and market research
  • Identify relevant trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Prepare briefing notes and strategic insights
  • Incorporate research findings into valuation assumptions and transaction materials

Analyst Review & Senior Banker Support

  • Review analyst work for accuracy, consistency, and presentation quality
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to junior team members
  • Prepare VPs and Managing Directors for client meetings
  • Support senior bankers with models, transaction updates, and financial insights

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain confidentiality across sensitive transaction information
  • Ensure deliverables follow internal controls and applicable requirements
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready versions of financial models and transaction materials

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience in:
    • Investment Banking
    • Corporate Finance
    • Private Equity
  • Advanced Excel skills with strong financial modeling capabilities
  • Advanced PowerPoint and presentation skills
  • Strong understanding of:
    • DCF valuation
    • LBO modeling
    • Comparable company analysis
    • Precedent transaction analysis
  • Familiarity with Bloomberg, Capital IQ, FactSet, or PitchBook
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple live transactions and tight deadlines
  • Strong written and verbal English communication

Nice to Have

  • MBA, CFA, or CPA
  • VBA/macros experience
  • Experience across both buy-side and sell-side M&A
  • Capital raising experience
  • Exposure to industries such as:
    • Technology
    • Healthcare
    • Real Estate
    • Financial Services
  • Previous experience mentoring or reviewing analyst work

What Success Looks Like

  • Highly accurate financial models and valuation analyses
  • Pitch books, CIMs, and investor materials delivered on time
  • Smooth management of due diligence and transaction workstreams
  • Strong quality control across analyst deliverables
  • Positive feedback from clients and senior bankers
  • Multiple live transactions managed effectively without sacrificing accuracy

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start by updating a valuation model with new client financials, then review analyst work before preparing materials for an upcoming client meeting.

Throughout the day, you’ll coordinate due diligence requests, update data rooms, conduct market research, refine a CIM or pitch book, and communicate with advisors and client stakeholders.

In short: you help drive transactions from financial analysis through execution while ensuring senior bankers and clients can rely on the accuracy and quality of every deliverable.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct exposure to live M&A and capital raising transactions
  • Advanced financial modeling and valuation experience
  • High visibility with senior bankers and clients
  • Opportunity to work across multiple industries and transaction types
  • Fully remote environment aligned with U.S. deal schedules
  • Career growth toward Vice President, Private Equity, Corporate Development, or Strategic Finance

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Pavago Recruiter Interview
  4. Technical Assessment – DCF or M&A Modeling Case
  5. Client Interview with Senior Bankers
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Apply Now

If you have strong M&A, financial modeling, valuation, and transaction execution experience and thrive in demanding deal environments, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.title: IT Client Technical Integration Specialist
raw.excerpt: Evri Group is the UK’s premier parcel delivery business, uniting four distinct brands—Evri, Evri Premium, a network of DHL, UK Mail and Irish e-commerce specialist Coll-8—to deliver more than 1 billion parcels and letters annually across the UK and to over 200 global destinations.
raw.description:
Evri Group is the UK’s premier parcel delivery business, uniting four distinct brands—Evri, Evri Premium, a network of DHL, UK Mail and Irish e-commerce specialist Coll-8—to deliver more than 1 billion parcels and letters annually across the UK and to over 200 global destinations. With 12,000 colleagues, 30,000 couriers and drivers, 8,000 vehicles, and a nationwide network of hubs, depots and fulfilment centres, we combine over 50 years of expertise with the scale and flexibility to support everyone from casual senders to SMEs and major retailers. Driven by our friendly, ambitious and diverse people, we are passionate about delivering exceptional service and offer exciting opportunities across the Evri Group.

Want to play a key role in delivering seamless technical onboarding for our clients? At Evri, our technology powers millions of deliveries, and our clients rely on accurate, reliable data connections to keep everything moving. We're looking for an IT Client Technical Integration Specialist to join us on a fixed-term contract until May 2027, playing a pivotal role in helping clients integrate seamlessly with our platforms and ensuring they can submit data, ship parcels and trade successfully with us at scale. If you enjoy solving technical challenges, building strong client relationships and working in a fast-paced environment, this could be the ideal next step in your career. You'll work closely with both clients and internal teams to deliver smooth integrations, resolve technical issues and support a best-in-class onboarding experience.

What you’ll be doing As an IT Client Technical Integration Specialist, you’ll deliver end to end technical onboarding and provide expert support across client integrations. Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver technical onboarding for customers from integration design through to live trading.
  • Configure and support integrations using REST/SOAP APIs, HTTP POST, FTP/SFTP and structured data files such as CSV, XML and JSON.
  • Validate shipment, manifest, label and event data to ensure compliance with Evri requirements.
  • Troubleshoot integration, connectivity and dataflow issues across customer, internal and third party systems.
  • Support integration testing activities ahead of go live.
  • Provide 2nd and 3rd line support for live integrations, resolving incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs.
  • Maintain integration specifications, technical documentation and SOPs in line with platform updates.
  • Work collaboratively with Sales, Client Management, Product, Development, Testing and Operations teams to support successful onboarding.

What you’ll bring We’re looking for someone who’s technically confident, client focused and able to translate complex integration requirements into clear, practical solutions.

  • Experience supporting commercially valuable clients with strong communication skills.
  • Understanding of API integrations and the ability to troubleshoot data exchanges.
  • Knowledge of file based integrations and data structures such as CSV, XML and JSON.
  • Strong attention to detail, especially around data accuracy and label compliance.
  • The ability to manage multiple integrations and prioritise effectively.
  • A calm, solutions focused approach, particularly during peak logistics periods.

Why Evri? At Evri, you’ll join a collaborative IT team where your expertise directly shapes the client experience. You’ll help deliver integrations that drive operational success, reduce disruption and enable clients to ship at scale with confidence. We are Evri. Where everyone is welcome. We’re excited for the future. Let’s shape it together.

Everyone Belongs at Evri GroupWe're committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and able to succeed.As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, a Silver-accredited Inclusive Employer, and through our partnership with Scope, we're working to make our workplace and recruitment process more accessible for everyone.We encourage candidates to request adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process and there are touchpoints through the application process to do so. Every application is reviewed by a member of our Talent Acquisition team meaning that we don't use AI to screen candidates.At Evri Group, we're building an environment where everyone can be themselves and thrive.

raw.description:
About Us:

Our purpose is to help clients exceed their financial health goals. Across the reimbursement cycle, our scalable solutions and clinical expertise help solve programmatic needs. Enabling our teams with leading technology allows analytics to guide our solutions and keeps us accountable achieving goals.

We build long-term careers by investing in YOU. We seek to create an environment that cultivates your professional development and personal growth, as we believe your success is our success.

JOB SUMMARY:

The PCR is responsible for performing customer service activities to service and collect patient accounts receivables for medical accounts. PCR will locate and communicate with patients via the telephone, email, chat, text, etc. to obtain repayment in full or to establish acceptable payment arrangements. Additionally, PCR will resolve issues of a non-routine nature as necessary as well as answer patient’s questions and research account changes when necessary and contract observance functions to ensure compliance of all company, client, and federal and state regulations.

Schedule:

Monday through Friday 9:00 am to 5:30 pm CST. One late night required– 10:30 am to 7:00 pm CST.

Rate:$16.50

This is a remote position.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
Note: The essential duties and responsibilities below are intended to describe the general duties and responsibilities of this position and are not intended to be an exhaustive statement of duties. This position may perform all or most of the primary duties listed below. Specific tasks, responsibilities or competencies may be documented in the Team Member’s performance objectives as outlined by the Team Member’s immediate Leadership Team Member.

This is a remote position.

  • Communicate with patients regarding the repayment of their medical debt.

  • Achieve assigned goals (resolutions, call quality, productivity standards – specified by line of business)

  • Provide customer service to patients resolving medical account balances.

  • Profile patients and obtain financial information. Update demographic and financial information on each call.

  • Negotiate the best possible arrangements.

  • Proficiency with company telephone system while placing outbound calls and accepting inbound calls.

  • Perform account research and route accounts through appropriate client workflows

  • Use job aids and crosswalks to answer patient questions and resolve accounts in an efficient manner.

  • Perform account research and document findings.

  • Effectively communicate with patients and client to obtain necessary account information.

  • Ensure strong communication skills to convey intricate account information.

  • Ensure all accounts are worked within client standards and Federal Regulations.

  • Maintain high quality account handling per client standards.

  • Work within FDCPA, state regulations, department/division & all Compliance Policies.

  • Maintain clear, concise, and accurate documentation of all attempts and/or contacts made and received for accounts in accordance with company and client specifications.

  • Maintain continuing education, training in industry career development

  • Maintain current knowledge of and comply with all federal and state rules and regulations governing phone calls, patient contacts, and collections including HIPAA, FDCPA, Privacy Act, FCRA, etc.

  • Attend training sessions as directed by management.

  • Integrate information obtained through training sessions and policy changes immediately into daily routine.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:
Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions as described. Regular eye-hand coordination and manual dexterity is required to operate office equipment. The ability to perform work at a computer terminal for 6-8 hours a day and function in an environment with constant interruptions is required. At times, Team Members are subject to sitting for prolonged periods. Infrequently, Team Member must be able to lift and move material weighing up to 20 lbs. Team Member may experience elevated levels of stress during periods of increased activity and with work entailing multiple deadlines.
A job description is only intended as a guideline and is only part of the Team Member’s function. The company has reviewed this job description to ensure that the essential functions and basic duties have been included. It is not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all functions, responsibilities, skills and abilities. Additional functions and requirements may be assigned by supervisors as deemed appropriate.

  • Solid, hands-on experience with TypeScript and React
  • Experience consuming REST or GraphQL APIs from backend microservices

  • An eye for accessibility, responsive design, and cross-browser behavior
  • An open mindset and strong critical thinking skills
  • Genuine experience with, and enthusiasm for, working with AI tools

Nice to Have

  • Experience with a design system or shared component library
  • Experience with Next.js
  • Experience with frontend observability and monitoring tooling

What we offer

  • Direct cooperation with already successful, long-term and growing project;
  • Health insurance with premium-level clinics;
  • Covered 20 days of vacations and 10 days of sick leave;
  • Your PE bookkeeping will be maintained by a professional accountant;
  • Last but not least — fair compensation for your efforts.
